jobs.excerpt: Do you know what product management is really about?
jobs.description:
Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.

At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.

The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for. That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.

We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.

This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest - 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time - kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself - Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people - Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness - Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation - Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

The Role

Purpose of the role

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.

You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening. On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.

Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.

You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.

Team

You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Your top five responsibilities

  1. Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
  2. Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.
  3. Ship AI that holds up in the real world: You'll take AI features from concept to production in a domain where being wrong has consequences. You'll design for human-in-the-loop where the stakes demand it, set the bar for evaluating output quality, and make sure we never ship something that sounds confident and is wrong.
  4. Drive the roadmap and the trade-offs: You'll sequence work into cycles, make the hard prioritisation calls, and communicate them clearly enough that everyone from an engineer to a founder understands why. You'll say no often and well.
  5. Grow yourself and others: We're big on learning and development. You'll raise the product craft around you, give and receive candid feedback, and help build a world-class product function as we scale.

Your Capabilities

You are a product person who is genuinely curious about how things work and impatient about whether they're actually helping anyone. You'd rather find out you were wrong in two weeks than be right in a year. You can hold a strong opinion and change it in front of evidence without ego.

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS products end to end, with a clear track record of driving business outcomes for customers - not just shipping features. You understand enterprise realities: long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement, security, adoption inside organisations that don't change easily.
  • Mastery (AI): Real, hands-on proficiency with AI. You've shipped or seriously prototyped AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs are good and bad at, and you can reason about retrieval and grounding, evaluation, hallucination risk, cost and latency trade-offs, and where a human must stay in the loop. You use AI tools daily in your own work and it shows.
  • Range: You can design for a user in a hi-vis vest with one hand free and poor signal, and for a director who needs to defend a number in a room full of people who'd rather they couldn't. Products that serve both are harder than products that serve either, and you find that interesting rather than annoying.
  • Communication: A clear and compelling communicator. You can make a complex product argument simple, write a crisp strategy document, and hold your own with both a site-based engineer and a senior business leader. You build relationships through a humanistic, empathetic approach, because our customers aren't just users!
  • Leadership: You take ownership. You don't wait for permission, you don't hide behind process, and you're comfortable making a decision with incomplete information and being accountable for it.
  • Impact: You can read between the lines, spot the opportunity nobody asked for, and measure whether it worked. You're rigorous with data but you don't hide behind it.
  • Domain: Ideally some experience in construction, engineering, real estate, or an adjacent complex operational industry (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, field services). What matters most is that you can get deep into a hard, physical, unglamorous domain and love it.

Nice to Have (If you don't have it now you will after joining)

  • Mastery: Experience with mobile-first or field-facing products used in tough physical conditions, and/or with commercial workflows, contracts, change control, claims, cost management, or with products where the output carries legal or contractual weight. If you're not an expert in construction or digital project delivery yet, you will be! We'll give you the tools and knowledge to speak the industry's language.
  • Communication: Experience taking a product to market with sales and marketing, and telling its story publicly, talks, writing, or an extensive network in construction and/or tech.
  • Leadership: Early leadership or people management exposure, experience coaching or mentoring other PMs. We're growing fast, and we want our best product people to step up and take on bigger responsibilities. If you're ambitious, there's a clear path to more.
  • Impact: Experience scaling a product from early traction to a genuine platform, and the scars that come with it. Beyond hitting delivery targets, you'll play a key role in shaping how construction teams adopt technology, and that's a rare thing to be able to say about your work.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on an outcome

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • What do you think you bring to the team?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly.

After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Work That Matters: You help connect families looking for quality child care with the businesses that serve them. The work you do directly supports the growth of child care and early education businesses.

Recession-Proof Growth: Join an established, fast-growing company operating in a market where effective marketing and lead generation remain essential.

Paid Days to Give Back: Receive 4 paid days per year to volunteer with a charity of your choice.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you’ll build strong relationships across your client portfolio and begin taking full ownership of client success. Ongoing success will be measured by:

  • Renewals: Retain and renew clients by consistently demonstrating the value we deliver.
  • Client Success: Help child care businesses achieve measurable marketing results.

Proactive & Organized: You stay ahead of deadlines, follow through on commitments, and manage multiple accounts without letting things slip.

Results-Driven: You are comfortable with data and use performance insights to guide decisions and demonstrate value.

Consultative Seller: You recognize opportunities to help clients do more and can recommend additional services naturally and confidently.

Ownership Mindset: You treat each client's business as if it were your own and take responsibility for outcomes.

  • You want to simply pass messages between clients and internal teams rather than own outcomes.
  • You are uncomfortable discussing performance, renewals, upsells, or challenging client conversations.
  • You need constant reminders to follow up, document next steps, or stay ahead of deadlines.

  • Previous marketing agency experience.
  • Proven experience upselling or growing existing client accounts.
  • Google Ads and/or Meta advertising certifications.
  • Experience with GoHighLevel, ClickUp, or similar marketing platforms.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position.

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow through smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

We’re looking for a seasoned Security Engineer who has started applying that expertise to AI/ML systems. You don’t need to have spent years in a dedicated AI security role; what matters is that you’ve got the security depth and the curiosity to learn fast in a space that’s evolving quickly.

Working under the Director of Security Engineering & Operations, you’ll drive security implementation, automation, and compliance across our AI/ML development lifecycle — collaborating closely with Architecture, Product Development, Platform, DevOps, and IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Assess and mitigate security risks specific to AI/ML systems — including model integrity, data poisoning, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, and agentic AI threat vectors
  • Implement and maintain security processes, tooling, and automation across AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure
  • Define and enforce secure AI development and delivery practices across the SDLC
  • Evaluate and help secure agentic AI systems, including multi-agent architectures, tool-use frameworks, and autonomous decision-making pipelines
  • Contribute to AI governance initiatives, including policy development, risk assessments, and responsible AI frameworks aligned with regulatory and industry standards
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed AI security controls across engineering and operations teams
  • Own AI security projects end-to-end, from conception through delivery
  • Develop and maintain technical security documentation for AI systems and models
  • Support compliance initiatives, audits, and technical assessments relevant to AI/ML environments

Required

  • Proven success driving cross-functional security initiatives in an agile SaaS development organization

    • Security architecture and implementation in context of microservice, cloud-native, and serverless application architectures
    • GitOps implementation, security, and utilization
    • Security tooling and automation development, as software
    • Continuous security and compliance
  • Recent hands-on exposure to securing AI/ML environments

  • with AI/ML workloads

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

At Lumen, we are igniting business growth by connecting people, data, and applications quickly, securely, and effortlessly. As a Lead IT Systems Analyst (Software Asset Management) within the Vendor Management Office (VMO), you will play a critical role in optimizing Lumen's software investments and driving strategic vendor partnerships that support our technology transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to technical, procurement, and business leaders, helping guide software purchasing, licensing, renewal, and vendor management decisions across a software portfolio exceeding $200 million annually. You will leverage data-driven insights, financial analysis, and industry best practices to maximize value, reduce risk, and ensure alignment between software investments and business objectives.

This is an opportunity for a collaborative, analytical leader who enjoys influencing decisions, improving processes, and delivering measurable impact across a complex enterprise environment.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Partner with technical teams, Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders to develop software acquisition, renewal, and optimization strategies.
  • Lead analysis and recommendations for software maintenance and subscription renewals, modifications, or cancellations across a large enterprise software portfolio.
  • Perform financial, operational, licensing, and risk assessments to support informed decision-making and maximize return on software investments.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals, licensing models, and contract terms to ensure alignment with business requirements and long-term flexibility.
  • Support and influence negotiation strategies for high-value software transactions and key licensing agreements.
  • Lead complex software asset management and license compliance initiatives, ensuring accurate entitlement tracking and effective utilization of software assets.
  • Develop, improve, and standardize Software Asset Management (SAM) processes, metrics, and best practices to drive operational excellence.
  • Serve as a trusted consultant and primary point of contact for assigned teams, providing guidance on software licensing, vendor management, and risk mitigation.
  • Drive cross-functional projects and facilitate collaboration among stakeholders to achieve business objectives and resolve challenges efficiently.
  • Champion continuous improvement through process optimization, automation opportunities, knowledge sharing, and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Economics, Management Information Systems (MIS), Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of professional experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master's degree.
  • Experience managing software assets, software licensing, renewals, contract analysis, vendor management, or related IT procurement activities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate financial, contractual, operational, and licensing data to drive business outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across technical and non-technical organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment while exercising sound judgment.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with complex software licensing agreements for major vendors such as Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Red Hat, Salesforce, SAP, Adobe, and similar providers.
  • Experience supporting or leading multi-million-dollar software transactions and contract negotiations.
  • Familiarity with Software Asset Management platforms such as Flexera.
  • Experience with cloud providers including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Knowledge of purchasing, procurement, IT asset management, or vendor management processes within a large enterprise environment.
  • Master's degree in a related field.

jobs.title: AI Evaluation Engineer (Python, QA or Security)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

  • Leverage diagnostic tools such as browser developer tools, API testing platforms (e.g., Postman), and log analysis tools to investigate and troubleshoot technical issues with moderate guidance

  • Author and maintain Knowledgebase articles using KCS (Knowledge-Centered Service) methodologies to promote self-service and reduce case volume.

  • Maintain accurate and professional case documentation, ensuring all interactions are clear, concise, and actionable.

  • Analyze case trends and categorize incidents to identify root causes and inform product improvements.

  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams for service-related needs, ensuring a seamless support experience.

  • Stay current on product updates, new features, and industry best practices to provide informed support.

  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Embrace change and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the support organization.

What you'll bring:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a technical support, IT helpdesk, or contact center role, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently.

  • Familiarity with CRM or case management systems (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to evolving environments.

  • Customer-first mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.

  • Ability to collaborate across teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.

  • Experience with one or more of the following:

    • Educational or professional experience troubleshooting web applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure, or single-page applications.

    • General understanding of authentication processes, including Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

    • Prior experience in a technical support environment, especially supporting educational software, parents, or K–12 schools.

    • Familiarity with the North American education system.

    • Experience in Accounting or Finance, or hands-on experience in bookkeeping.

    • Proven technical troubleshooting experience in a customer-facing role.

    • Experience with merchant processing, payment facilitators, payment platforms, or credit card/payment services providers.

    • Understanding of APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) and their role in system integrations.

    • Experience troubleshooting email deliverability, including knowledge of SPF, DKIM, and DMARC protocols.

    • Familiarity with alternative payment methods such as PayPal, Venmo, and Apple Pay.

What our interviewing process looks like:

We take pride in finding the best talent for our team and utilize a multi-step interviewing process, starting with a recorded video interview. You can expect to hear from our recruiter soon.

Our Costa Rica Blackbaud team members are currently working from home and will stay in this format indefinitely.

Founded over 35 years ago, First Quality is a family-owned company that has grown from a small business in McElhattan, Pennsylvania into a group of companies, employing over 5,000 team members, while maintaining our family values and entrepreneurial spirit. With corporate offices in New York and Pennsylvania and 8 manufacturing campuses across the U.S. and Canada, the companies within the First Quality group produce high-quality personal care and household products for large retailers and healthcare organizations. Our personal care and household product portfolio includes baby diapers, wipes, feminine pads, paper towels, bath tissue, adult incontinence products, laundry detergents, fabric finishers, and dishwash solutions. In addition, we manufacture certain raw materials and components used in the manufacturing of these products, including flexible print and packaging solutions.

Guided by our values of humility, unity, and integrity, we leverage advanced technology and innovation to drive growth and create new opportunities. At First Quality, you’ll find a collaborative environment focused on continuous learning, professional development, and our mission to Make Things Better®.

We are seeking a Solution Engineer – Data Center Services​for our First Quality Enterprises company working remotely.

The Data Center and Cloud Services Team within Infrastructure provides strategic direction, technical/functional expertise, and platform management for First Quality’s Server and Compute solutions which include: HCI Infrastructure, Virtual Machines, Cloud Services, Active Directory, and related components as well as the tools and platforms that support the compute, storage, and backup systems at First Quality. The Solutions Engineer – Data Center and Cloud Services as a key member of the Solution Delivery team, provides functional and technical leadership for the delivery of First Quality’s IT Infrastructure.

This position is responsible for the design, build, and deployment of the assigned systems and technologies. The person in this role will interact with team members at manufacturing sites and data centers as well as work directly with the Data Center & Cloud Architects to develop functional specifications and execute on the delivery of solutions including integration with other FQ systems and infrastructure.

The Solutions Engineer is responsible for build activities with a focus on hardware, software, and applications in our Data Centers and cloud environments which include but are not limited to: HCI Hardware for Virtual Workloads and Bare Metal Servers, Data Protection Platform Hardware and Systems, Enterprise Virtualization Platforms and hypervisor, Virtual Desktop Solutions, Cloud Services, and OS (Windows and Linux) server build administration and life cycle.

This position serves as a “build resource” for servers, storage, and backup services and, as such provides service transition to the Operations and Support Organization (L2) following completion of Infrastructure builds. Additionally, this role is responsible for serving as the L3 escalation point for these services. The person in this position owns their assigned system(s) and interacts with all divisions and departments within First Quality.

This person carries the responsibility for the build execution of the server / storage / backup services with the goal of fully utilizing their capabilities. The person in this position will work closely with the leaders and associates of First Quality’s IT and Security organizations to maintain a complete end-to-end Infrastructure systems lifecycle (architecture to delivery to support).

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Primary responsibility is the delivery of approved projects and associated solutions.

  • Works closely with Solution Architects to create functional specifications, and low-level technical designs.

  • Delivers high quality infrastructure and services to the business which meet desired requirements both on time and up to standards.

  • Creates test plans, test scripts, and executes to ensure the services operate as expected.

  • Partners with the Information Security Team to ensure the security posture of their solutions meets industry standards and aligns with First Quality best practices.

  • Develops all the required technical documentation, drawings, and release notes content at time of delivery to be provided to Operations Team for ongoing support. Also helps develop operational procedures documents for the Support and Operations Teams to follow.

  • Assists with project planning and scheduling and managing of projects

  • Delivers effective communications both written and verbal.

  • Attends customer / internal customer facing meetings as required to properly gather requirements and understand the business need

  • Ensures adherence to IT Architecture principles and guidelines.

  • Acts as a Level 3 escalation for support activities.

  • Updates job knowledge by attending educational opportunities and training events.

The ideal candidate should possess the following:

  • Minimum 7-10+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.

  • Knowledge and experience in Data Center and Server Infrastructure - Data Center operations and maintenance, Server Hardware, HCI Server Solutions – (such as Dell VxRail, HPE Greenlake, Cisco UCS)

  • Strong Virtualization Infrastructure Experience: (such as VMware / vCloud Foundation, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV/Prism)

  • Understanding of Enterprise Backup Systems and data protection platforms.

  • Experience with Active Directory including User/Group/Computer Management, Domain Services Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and Authentication.

  • Windows Server OS – 2016 to 2025

  • Experience with Linux Server Build and Management (Red Hat or Ubuntu).

  • Scripting capabilities for Infrastructure data gathering and remediations– PowerShell and VMware PowerCLI preferred. JSON, YAML and Terraform knowledge a plus.

  • Has a strong focus on security when designing or engineering solutions for Infrastructure

  • Experience evaluating products and solutions for procurement.

  • Familiar with a variety of Information Technology concepts, practices, and procedures including server security hardening both on premise and in the cloud.

  • Strong problem solving and decision-making skills with excellent written and verbal communications skills.

  • Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.

  • Able to overcome obstacles and get things done in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in ITSM Change and Configuration Management required.

  • Experience in Manufacturing Environments is a plus but not required.

Desired:

  • Familiarity with deployment of workloads using Terraform or Azure DevOps processes and setting up workloads in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS a plus

  • Experience with public cloud vendors (Azure, AWS, GCS), and building Hybrid Cloud with On Premise –Infrastructure.

  • Experience and familiarity with GenAI platforms.

  • ITSM/ITIL project and process management skillset

  • Familiarity with Virtual Desktop Technologies and Platforms - Horizon View, Citrix, M365 DaaS.

What We Offer You

We believe that by continuously improving the quality of our benefits, we can help to raise the quality of life for our team members and their families. At First Quality you will receive:

  • Competitive base salary and bonus opportunities

  • Paid time off (three-week minimum)

  • Medical, dental and vision starting day one

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Paid parental leave

  • Child and family care assistance (dependent care FSA with employer match up to $2500)

  • Bundle of joy benefit (year's worth of free diapers to all team members with a new baby)

  • Tuition assistance

  • Wellness program with savings of up to $4,000 per year on insurance premiums

  • ...and more!

First Quality is committed to protecting information under the care of First Quality Enterprises commensurate with leading industry standards and applicable regulations. As such, First Quality provides at least annual training regarding data privacy and security to employees who, as a result of their role specifications, may come in to contact with sensitive data.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

Join us in our mission to create solutions that help keep children safe online.

Headquartered in Perth, Australia, with offices around the world, Qoria is an ASX-listed global leader in child digital safety technology and services. We are a purpose-driven business operating under the Linewize brand in North America and Asia Pacific, the Smoothwall brand in the UK, the Qustodio brand in EMEA, and Qoria LK in Sri Lanka.

Our solutions are used by schools, school districts, and parental communities to protect children from harmful online content, identify students at risk based on their digital behaviours, and help teachers maintain focus and safe learning environments in the digital classroom. Today, 30,000 schools and 7 million parents rely on our solutions to help keep 25 million children safe across 180 countries worldwide.

Location:UK-based only (Must already reside in the UK).

What’s the position?

At Smoothwall, we believe every child deserves to explore the digital world safely. As an Associate Education Monitoring Analyst, you’ll play a crucial role in providing human moderation support for our Smoothwall Monitor Managed Service offering.

As a member of our Product team, you will monitor students' online activities worldwide to identify potential safeguarding risks and, when necessary, liaise with Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) within schools.

The work requires a keen eye for detail, an understanding of modern online culture amongst young people and an ability to work at pace whilst making accurate decisions.

This isn’t just a job; it’s a purpose. You’ll be part of a passionate team working at the intersection of technology and wellbeing, using your analytical skills and cultural awareness to make a tangible difference every day.

  • A strong work ethic and ability to stay focused for extended periods
  • Excellent customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills, including verbal, written, and numerical proficiency.
  • Collaborative team player, capable of working effectively within a large team.

Desirable

Personal Characteristics

Summary:

We are seeking a highly analytical and customer-focused Product Manager to join our Controlled Substances Reporting team. This role is ideal for a data-focused Product Manager with a strong product foundation who is ready to go deep — building rare, hard-to-develop expertise in one of healthcare's most complex and highly regulated domains, where data quality, regulatory nuance, and customer trust are everything.

As a Product Manager, you will establish yourself as the subject matter expert in Controlled Substance data and reporting solutions, partnering with customers, engineering, analytics, and product leadership to develop products that deliver meaningful value to healthcare organizations, pharmacies, government agencies, and other stakeholders.

Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency in SQL and Tableau, and the ability to translate complex customer, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable product solutions.

Active, fluent use of AI-supported tools is essential to operating effectively at this scale. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and excited to use data-driven insights to influence product decisions.

  • Build relationships with customers and stakeholders while contributing requirements and recommendations informed by data and feedback.
  • Begin leveraging AI-supported tools to improve research, documentation, and product execution.

  • Become a trusted resource for Controlled Substance reporting, data, and customer workflows.
  • Independently lead discovery, customer conversations, and requirements gathering for product enhancements.
  • Proactively identify product opportunities using customer feedback, data analysis, and market insights.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality requirements, documentation, and recommendations while maintaining an effective AI-enabled workflow.

  • Independently lead complex product initiatives from discovery through delivery, partnering effectively across customers, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality requirements, documentation, and product recommendations that drive customer and business outcomes.
  • Proactively identify data quality issues, customer pain points, and product opportunities, making well-reasoned recommendations and driving solutions forward.
  • Leverage AI-supported tools and automation to improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of your product work.

What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, product analytics, data analysis, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in scope and ownership.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including the ability to independently query and analyze large, complex datasets.
  • Proficiency with Tableau, including dashboard development, data visualization, and analytical storytelling.
  • Experience translating business needs and data insights into product recommendations, requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and creativity in designing solutions.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated industry such as healthcare, government, insurance, or financial services.
  • Experience working with healthcare, pharmacy, public health, claims, or controlled substance data.

What You Get:

  • Build deep, rare expertise in a specialized and high-impact domain — controlled substance data that touches pharmacies, government agencies, and health systems across the country.

Belonging at Bamboo

Every human being has the right to the best possible healthcare. At BR-DGE, our Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) is a core engineer who architects, builds, and scales our automated testing infrastructure and quality tooling in Java. You will write production-grade code that enables our teams to ship high quality software frequently and with total confidence - not execute test cases.

You will not sit at the end of a delivery pipeline manually validating tickets or acting as a gatekeeper. You will not be running scripted or exploratory manual tests. Instead, you own the technical design, development, and evolution of our centralised automation frameworks and infrastructure, engineering systemic solutions that let development teams own their own quality and deploy safely.

  • CI / CD and Pipeline Engineering: Heavy hands-on experience building, optimising, and maintaining CI / CD pipelines, with a focus on fast, parallelised execution and automated gates.
  • Cloud Native Architecture: Deep understanding of distributed system design, microservices, and cloud native environments, with the ability to optimise them for logging, observability, and testability.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalyst

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will embed complex, high-priority products and related product teams to accelerate Amgen’s adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), strengthen the product management capability, and help teams shift from output to outcome mindsets. Reporting to the Director, Product Management Catalysts, this individual contributor role will serve as a senior hands-on player-coach, partnering directly with Digital Product Managers, business leads, technology leads, data scientists, compliance and quality partners, adjacent product teams, product group leaders, and senior functional stakeholders.

This role will primarily embed with complex, interdependent individual products, though may operate across multiple related product teams when dependencies, stakeholder complexity, or where product outcomes require it. The Associate Director will coach and upskill DPMs and cross-functional teams while helping them apply DPOM practices to real product work. When no DPM is assigned, this role may temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning senior stakeholders, defining outcomes, resolving trade-offs, and supporting roadmap and prioritization decisions.

The Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts will help teams clarify high-priority business and user problems, shape product strategy, define measurable outcomes, improve roadmaps, establish OKRs and KPIs, support discovery, improve prioritization, manage cross-product dependencies, and connect delivery work to measurable value. This role will also capture learnings from embedded engagements and contribute insights back to the Product Management Hub to improve DPOM playbooks, tools, standards, Catalyst practices, and enterprise adoption approaches.

Responsibilities:

Embedded Product Leadership and Coaching

• Embed with complex, high-priority products and related product teams to improve product management practices and accelerate DPOM adoption.

• Serve as a senior hands-on player-coach to Digital Product Managers and cross-functional team members.

• Coach DPMs on advanced product management skills, including complex problem framing, continuous discovery, product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment trade-offs, stakeholder alignment, and value measurement.

• When no DPM is assigned, temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning stakeholders, defining outcomes, and supporting roadmap, capacity, and prioritization decisions.

• Coach teams to combine user insights, product data, business context, and experimentation to make evidence-based product decisions.

• Help teams move from stakeholder-request and feature-based delivery toward empowered, outcome-driven product management.

DPOM Adoption and Cross-Functional Team Enablement

• Help cross-functional teams understand and apply DPOM practices in complex product environments.

• Partner with business leads, technology leads, business analysts, design, data, compliance, quality, and adjacent product teams to strengthen product ways of working.

• Help teams clarify roles, decision rights, operating rhythms, success measures, dependencies, and expectations within the Digital Product Operating Model.

• Identify product management capability gaps, adoption barriers, and recurring anti-patterns across complex product environments.

• Support teams in building durable product habits that continue after the Catalyst engagement ends.

Product Strategy, Outcomes, and Prioritization

• Connect enterprise and business unit strategy to product strategy, helping teams break silos and translate strategic objectives into product outcomes and investment decisions.

• Help teams frame complex, high-priority user and business problems and connect product work to measurable outcomes.

• Support development of product vision, strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment recommendations, and value realization plans.

• Guide teams in making trade-off recommendations based on user needs, business value, feasibility, risk, capacity, dependencies, and enterprise priorities.

• Support discovery, validation, and learning practices that help teams make better product decisions in ambiguous environments.

• Help teams improve roadmap quality by shifting from feature and output lists to problem, opportunity, and outcome-oriented roadmaps that reflect product strategy, capacity, dependencies, and measurable value.

Cross-Product Dependencies and Stakeholder Influence

• Identify and help resolve cross-product dependencies, sequencing challenges, and prioritization conflicts that affect product outcomes.

• Influence business leads, technology leads, product group leaders, senior functional stakeholders, compliance partners, and adjacent product teams without formal authority.

• Communicate clearly with team-level and senior stakeholders on product direction, adoption progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions needed.

• Help teams align near-term delivery decisions with longer-term product strategy and measurable outcomes.

• Escalate major blockers, trade-offs, or alignment issues to the Director, Product Management Catalysts when needed.

Catalyst Model Execution and Continuous Improvement

• Execute the Catalyst engagement model, including product/team assessment, engagement planning, embedded coaching, adoption measurement, transition planning, and learning capture.

• Contribute to refinement of the Catalyst model based on practical learnings from complex embedded engagements.

• Define and track success measures for each engagement, including DPM capability growth, cross-functional team adoption, product maturity, product outcomes when directly accountable, and sustained DPOM adoption outcomes following Catalyst transition.

• Surface insights, risks, and recommendations to the Director, Product Management Catalysts and Product Management Hub leadership.

• Translate lessons from embedded work into reusable examples, practices, templates, and playbook improvements.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Director, Digital Product Management we seek is a senior product practitioner and coach with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree and 3 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
  • Master’s degree and 5 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
  • Associate’s degree and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
  • High school diploma / GED and 14 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, including product strategy, discovery, road mapping, prioritization, delivery, and outcome measurement.
  • Experience owning or leading complex, interdependent, high-priority products or product initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or upskill product managers, product owners, business partners, and cross-functional team members.
  • Strong product management craft, including user and customer problem definition, product discovery, roadmap development, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, investment trade-off recommendations, and value realization.
  • Experience influencing senior business, technology, product, engineering, data, compliance, and adjacent product stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Ability to operate as a senior hands-on player-coach, balancing direct product leadership with coaching and capability building.
  • Proven ability to help teams shift from output-oriented delivery to outcome-oriented product management.
  • Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, including the ability to frame complex problems, resolve dependencies, make trade-off recommendations, and create practical paths forward.
  • Experience contributing to product operating models, playbooks, standards, templates, training, or adoption approaches preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
  • Familiarity with AI-native product development, generative AI workflows, responsible AI principles, and the evolving role of AI in product management preferred.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

jobs.excerpt: Wir wollen digitale ärztliche Beratung für jeden in Deutschland zugänglich machen.
jobs.description:
Wir wollen digitale ärztliche Beratung für jeden in Deutschland zugänglich machen. Wirklich für jeden! Um das zu erreichen, bauen wir die führende On-Demand-Plattform für Telemedizin. Und Dein Beitrag zählt.

Suchst du mehr als nur einen neuen Job? Eine sinnvolle Aufgabe, die dich richtig stolz macht? Herzlichen Willkommen! Wir sind TeleClinic, die führende Telemedizin-Plattform in Deutschland.
Die Digitalisierung des deutschen Gesundheitswesens ist in vollem Gange und wir bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, uns auf diesem revolutionären Weg zu begleiten. Werde Teil von TeleClinic und spiele eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung einer gesünderen Gesellschaft.

Vier Millionen Behandlungen, 4,9 Sterne: TeleClinic ist Deutschlands führende Plattform für Online-Arztbesuche. Unser Anspruch: eine Loved Brand, bei der jeder Touchpoint eine 5-Sterne-Experience ist – und die für Patient:innen zu einem festen, alltäglichen Begleiter für ihre Gesundheit wird. Zu einer App, die sie nicht nur einmal, sondern immer wieder von sich aus öffnen: täglich, wöchentlich, monatlich, für die unterschiedlichsten Gesundheitsanliegen.
Als Senior Product Manager – Patient Experience (m/w/d) gestaltest du das auf iOS, Android und Web, mit Engagement und Retention als deinen North Star Metriken – und trägst so dazu bei, TeleClinic zu einer der meistgenutzten Gesundheits-Apps in Deutschland zu machen.

Deine Rolle

  • Strategie & Roadmap-Ownership: Die Ziele der Patient Experience Mission geben dir die Richtung vor, die Roadmap gestaltest du. Du findest die Hebel, die die 5*-Experience der Patient:Innen treibt und entwickelst unsere Ziele iterativ weiter.

  • End-to-End Discovery: Du findest echte Patient:innen-Probleme in Feedback, Daten und Markt, entwickelst schnell Ideen und schätzt ihren Impact. In enger Abstimmung mit deinem eigenen und anderen Teams wird daraus ein priorisiertes Konzept: geschnitten, abgestimmt, (KI-)prototypisiert, bereit zur Umsetzung und von vorne bis hinten in deiner Verantwortung.

  • Experimente & Iteration: Bevor du ein Feature ausbaust, testest du die Hypothese. Du designst Experimente end-to-end, definierst Erfolgskriterien und validierst durch User-Feedback und Daten was funktioniert und was nicht. Nach dem Experiment entscheidest du über Rollout oder Rollback.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Patient Growth, Patient Partnerships, Doctor Experience und weiteren Missions zusammen, um herausragende End-to-End-Patient-Journeys zu schaffen.

  • Team: Du steuerst die Roadmap deiner Mission im Trio mit einem Engineering Manager und einem Product Designer, unterstützt von neun Engineers inklusive QA. iOS, Android, Web, Low Code: Nichts in unserem Stack begrenzt, was du Patient:innen zur Verfügung stellen kannst.

Dein Profil

  • Product Craft: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Manager:in für Consumer-Produkte, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Product Experience und Engagement.

  • Discovery: Erfahrung darin, die Richtung in unklaren Problemfeldern zu schärfen, Teams auf eine klare Strategie auszurichten und diese in Produktlösungen zu übersetzen.

  • Produktgespür: Du erkennst, wann eine Lösung gut genug ist und wann nicht — und kannst begründen, warum. Ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Verständnis und ein Blick für die Details, die Patient:innen begeistern, sind dabei ein klares Plus.

  • Plattform: Erfahrung mit nativen iOS, Android und React Anwendungen. Gutes Verständnis von technischen Voraussetzungen und Limitierungen der Plattformen.

  • Kommunikation & Dokumentation: In einer remote-first Arbeitsumgebung baust du auf exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation und Dokumentation um Stakeholder hinter deiner Vision zu vereinen.

  • Daten: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Nutzung von Analysetools wie Metabase, Mixpanel oder Vergleichbarem, um Potenziale abzuschätzen, Nutzerverhalten zu quantifizieren und Experimente auszuwerten.

  • Prozess & Team: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Discovery- und Delivery-Prozesse eines Produktteams aktiv zu gestalten und dessen Effektivität und Effizienz kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Sprache: Unsere Arbeitssprache ist Englisch, unsere Patient:innen schreiben Deutsch. Du bewegst dich sicher in beidem.

Unsere Gehälter basieren auf objektiven, rollenbezogenen Kriterien und sind an die lokalen Marktstandards des jeweiligen Einstellungslandes angepasst. Dein zuständiger Recruiter teilt die relevanten Gehaltsbänder gerne vor deinem ersten Interviewmit dir.

AGFA HealthCare is seeking an operational Director, Information Security to define and execute the company’s global cybersecurity vision across all business units and geographies. This role provides enterprise-wide security leadership with primary operational focus on cloud-native and SaaS platforms, while maintaining oversight of legacy on‑premise environments.

The leader is accountable for measurable security outcomes, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of healthcare data and systems, strengthening regulatory posture, and reinforcing trust in AGFA HealthCare’s imaging and informatics platforms. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines strategic partnership at the enterprise level with execution-oriented ownership of security operations.

Location:

What You'll Do:

  • Scaled and resilient security operations capabilities aligned with business growth and risk maturity.
  • Material reduction in critical and high-risk security findings through preventive controls and remediation.
  • Successful ISO 27001 / ISO 27017 / ISO 27018 HITRUST audit outcomes, with improved audit efficiency year over year.
  • Demonstrated adoption of Secure-by-Design and DevSecOps practices across cloud and on-premise products and R&D pipelines.
  • Improved executive visibility into cyber risk with actionable, business-oriented reporting.

Operational Oversight

  • Provide leadership and direction for security operations across AGFA HealthCare, including cloud and on‑premise environments.
  • Establish, scale, and continuously improve SOC capabilities, ensuring effective detection, response, and recovery aligned with business needs and risk profile.
  • Oversee threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and incident response with a focus on automation and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with CloudOps and DevOps teams to integrate DevSecOps practices into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Optimize and scale security tooling, including AWS-native services and endpoint protection platforms.

Risk, Compliance, and Governance

  • Ensure compliance with global security and privacy standards across cloud and on‑premise environments.
  • Oversee risk assessments, privacy impact analyses, and security reviews.
  • Maintain and evolve the incident response program in partnership with Legal, Privacy, ISP, and Quality and Regulatory teams.

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and execute AGFA HealthCare’s enterprise information security strategy in alignment with business goals, healthcare regulations, and patient safety priorities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the board on cyber risk posture, emerging threats, and security investment priorities.
  • Serve as an executive customer-facing security leader, engaging directly with clients to articulate the company’s security strategy, build trust, address risk and compliance concerns, and support sales efforts by positioning security as a strategic business enabler
  • Lead the development and evolution of governance frameworks, policies, and standards supporting HIPAA, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2.
  • Embed security by design across products, platforms, imaging workflows, and the full data lifecycle, including third‑party and embedded solutions.
  • Partner with Marketing and commercial teams to articulate AGFA HealthCare’s security posture and trust narrative to the market.
  • Champion a strong culture of security awareness, education, and accountability across R&D, CloudOps, and customer-facing teams.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity with 5+ years leading enterprise security programs or functions; proven leadership in high-growth or highly regulated environments.
  • Demonstrated success designing and operating security programs aligned to leading frameworks and sustaining regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
  • Expert ability to identify, prioritize, and communicate risk; proven track record translating complex technical concepts into actionable insights and decisions for executive, Board, and technical audiences.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and collaboration skills; experienced at influencing product, engineering, IT, legal, compliance, and operations stakeholders.
  • Advanced knowledge across core security domains: endpoint protection, monitoring/telemetry, DLP, IAM/zero trust, vulnerability/patch management, incident response, cloud and infrastructure security, authentication/authorization, and sensitive data protection.
  • Experience leading incident response, resiliency programs, and crisis management, including executive and Board-level reporting.

Our Values:

  • Advanced security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Certified Security).

What we offer now and in the future:
