Job Description

NetImpact is seeking a mid-level UX Designer to join the AI Forge Product Team. This role will shape intuitive, efficient, and trustworthy experiences that help technical and nontechnical experts use AI to understand, produce, verify, and evolve software solutions. The UX Designer will work closely with product management, engineering, AI, architecture, quality, and delivery teams to translate complex workflows into clear journeys, interactions, and interfaces.

AI Forge™ is NetImpact Strategies’ commercial platform for AI-enabled software production and sustainment. It applies AI across the complete software lifecycle—from understanding and requirements through architecture, verification, software generation, release, and sustainment. AI Forge goes beyond code generation by helping teams produce and continuously evolve the complete software solution, including implementation, requirements, designs, tests, documentation, deployment products, traceability, and other supporting products.

Responsibilities

  • Own UX activities from discovery through validated design for assigned AI Forge capabilities and workflows.
  • Translate complex software-lifecycle activities—including requirements analysis, architecture, generation, verification, traceability, synchronization, and change assessment—into usable product experiences.
  • Design human-AI interactions that clearly communicate system status, sources, assumptions, confidence, limitations, and recommended next actions.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, information architectures, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and production-ready interface designs.
  • Plan and conduct user interviews, workflow observations, usability studies, concept tests, and design validation with internal and customer users.
  • Design review, approval, correction, comparison, versioning, feedback, and exception-handling experiences that keep human judgment and accountability central.
  • Partner with product managers to clarify user problems, refine requirements, prioritize opportunities, and define measurable experience outcomes.
  • Collaborate with engineers to evaluate feasibility, resolve tradeoffs, support implementation, and assess delivered quality.
  • Contribute reusable components, interaction patterns, content guidance, and accessibility standards to the AI Forge design system.
  • Use AI-enabled research, prototyping, synthesis, and design tools thoughtfully to increase speed while independently validating outputs.
  • Document design rationale and communicate recommendations clearly to technical leaders, delivery teams, and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in user experience, interaction design, human-computer interaction, visual design, a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Three or more years of professional experience in UX design for complex digital products.
  • Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product thinking, including discovery, problem framing, interaction design, prototyping, validation, iteration, and shipped outcomes.
  • Strong knowledge of user-centered design, interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and usability principles.
  • Proficiency with Figma or comparable design and prototyping tools, including components, variants, libraries, and developer handoff.
  • Experience designing data-rich, workflow-heavy, enterprise, developer, or business applications.
  • Experience conducting practical user research and translating findings into clear product decisions.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design, including WCAG-informed practices.
  • Ability to reduce technical complexity without hiding information users need to make sound decisions.
  • Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions using evidence.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fully remote, cross-functional environment.
  • US Citizenship with ability to obtain Federal Government clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience designing AI-assisted, generative-AI, agentic, recommendation, automation, or decision-support experiences.
  • Understanding of human-AI UX considerations such as uncertainty, explainability, controllability, trust calibration, error recovery, provenance, feedback, and human oversight.
  • Experience prototyping AI interactions and testing both ideal paths and failure states created by variable model outputs.
  • Experience with developer tools, software engineering platforms, DevSecOps products, enterprise SaaS, or other technically complex systems.
  • Familiarity with software development concepts, APIs, version control, requirements management, testing, CI/CD, cloud environments, or product analytics.
  • Experience designing for regulated, security-conscious, government, or mission-oriented environments.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first.We are seeking a skilled Decision Intelligence Engineer to design, train, and continuously improve the reinforcement learning policy at the heart of Humana's Next Best Action platform. In this role you will own the full RL development lifecycle from feature engineering and reward design through distributed training, evaluation, and production deployment ensuring that every decision the platform makes for our 8 million members is informed by a policy that learns and improves with every interaction. You will work at the intersection of healthcare outcomes and decision engineering, translating member journey data into durable, explainable, and auditable decisioning intelligence.

This role is hands-on and research-oriented: you will implement and evaluate RL algorithms, instrument training pipelines, collaborate closely with data and platform engineers, and ensure the model operates correctly within the constraints of clinical eligibility rules and program-specific reward structures.

Key Responsibilities

Reinforcement Learning Model Development

  • Design, implement, and evaluate RL algorithms suited to long-horizon, sparse-reward healthcare decisioning, including policy gradient methods (PPO, A3C), value-based approaches (DQN, Q-learning), and offline RL methods (CQL, Decision Transformer).

  • Define and maintain the member state representation and action space, evolving both as new programs and data sources are onboarded.

  • Apply the Bellman equation, reward shaping, and constraint mapping to encode clinical eligibility, suppression rules, and program-specific objectives directly into the learning objective.

  • Manage exploration-exploitation tradeoffs appropriate for a production healthcare environment where poorly explored actions have real member impact.

Model Evaluation and Production Safety

  • Build simulation and backtesting environments to evaluate policy quality before production promotion, using historical member journey data.

  • Diagnose and remediate common RL failure modes: policy collapse, credit assignment errors across long member journeys, and distributional shift between training and serving populations.

  • Define reward threshold criteria and automated evaluation gates within the nightly Databricks training workflow; block promotion of underperforming policies to MLflow production.

  • Instrument training runs with MLflow tracking hyperparameters, reward curves, action distribution, and feature importance for every training cycle.

Training Pipeline Engineering

  • Own the nightly Databricks training workflow: feature engineering from Gold Activity History and Gold Patient Profile, state vector normalization, distributed RL training via Ray RLlib, and batch scoring of all 8M eligible members.

  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering team (Decisioning Team 2) to ensure training inputs are correctly joined, reward signals are accurately computed from disposition outcomes, and the feature pipeline is reproducible and auditable.

  • Write production-quality PySpark feature engineering jobs; maintain data lineage through Databricks Unity Catalog.

  • Manage model artifacts, versioning, and lifecycle in the MLflow Model Registry; ensure rollback capability is maintained at all times.

Multi-Agent and Constraint-Aware Decisioning

  • Apply multi-agent RL concepts (MARL via PettingZoo) where member household or population-level coordination is required.

  • Implement constraint mapping to enforce hard business rules — member caps, cooldown periods, clinical eligibility — as constraints within the RL objective rather than downstream filters.

  • Collaborate with the Rules Engine team to ensure Drools eligibility guards and RL policy priorities are correctly aligned and do not conflict.

Collaboration and Governance

  • Partner with Decisioning Team 1 (Decision Engine, Rules Engine) to ensure model outputs integrate cleanly with the real-time decisioning hot path and that scored recommendations cached in Redis are correctly structured and interpreted.

  • Collaborate with platform architects to define feedback loop contracts: how disposition outcomes flow from Kafka back through Databricks Delta Live Tables into the next training cycle.

  • Document model behavior, known limitations, and failure modes for clinical and compliance stakeholders; support explainability requirements for member-facing decisions.

  • Utilize AI-assisted engineering tools for scaffolding, testing, and documentation; ensure all core model logic and reward design remain human-authored and subject to rigorous peer review.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating large-scale production systems, with emphasis on data-intensive platforms, recommendation systems, or optimization engines serving millions of users.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing reinforcement learning or deep learning systems in production policy gradient methods (PPO, A3C), value-based approaches (DQN, Q-learning), or offline RL algorithms (CQL, Decision Transformer).

  • Deep familiarity with the Bellman equation, reward shaping, exploration-exploitation tradeoff, and constraint mapping in real-world RL systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose RL-specific failure modes: policy collapse, credit assignment issues, and distributional shift across large populations.

  • Proficiency in Python 3.x; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow for policy network implementation.

  • Experience with Ray RLlib for distributed RL training at scale.

  • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, and Delta Lake for large-scale ML pipelines processing tens of millions of records.

  • Experience with MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact management.

  • Track record of shipping ML systems that operate reliably under production load — not just research or prototype work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent RL frameworks (PettingZoo or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with probabilistic modeling, Markov Decision Processes, and linear programming for constraint-aware action selection.

  • Experience operating RL systems in regulated domains — healthcare, finance, or insurance — where member safety, auditability, and explainability are requirements.

  • Experience with Gymnasium for simulation environment development and backtesting.

  • Familiarity with Kafka-based feedback loops and how disposition signals feed RL retraining pipelines.

  • OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience for ML training pipeline observability.

Additional Information

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.

Work Style: Remote/Hybrid - Preferably Boston, MA. Occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. Mixpanel is building a vertical go-to-market motion — organizing enterprise sales by industry so we can sell in the buyer's language, with their use cases, and with proof from companies they recognize. This team is distinct from Mixpanel's Named Account team, which owns renewals and growth on the existing customer base; this team's mandate is net-new enterprise logos and expansion within a vertical.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Account Executive, Verticalized Sales to own growth within an industry vertical across North American markets. You'll drive net-new enterprise pipeline and expansion within your vertical, running full-cycle enterprise deals from first meeting to close. Beyond your own territory, you'll build deep vertical expertise and put it to use — shaping the discovery questions, messaging, and competitive positioning your peers rely on, and feeding what you learn in the field back into the team's playbooks. This role suits someone who's comfortable building in ambiguity, since the vertical model is still maturing and the playbooks are being built in real time.

  • Partner with Enablement on vertical fluency training and onboarding for the wider team as the vertical matures

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • A strong track record of full-cycle sales success, from net-new acquisition to customer expansion, across SMB to enterprise SaaS

  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Bring classically trained, broad software architecture expertise to the Digital Journey Architecture and
Solutions team. DJAS architects have developed deep knowledge of Lumen's systems through years of
embedded work - this role brings the architectural discipline, patterns, and methodologies that complement
that institutional depth. The Principal Software Architect raises the architectural quality bar across DJAS's
design work by bringing formal architecture practices, modern system design patterns, and a perspective
that isn't shaped entirely by how things have been done at Lumen.
This is not a domain specialist role. The value is breadth, discipline, and the ability to apply proven
architectural principles to complex, multi-system problems - including the emerging domain of

AI-augmented and agentic systems.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Apply proven software architecture principles to DJAS design work: microservices, event-driven
    patterns, distributed systems, API-first design, domain-driven design
  • Lead architecture design sessions and design reviews - challenge assumptions, surface tradeoffs,
    ensure solutions address NFRs (performance, reliability, scalability, observability, security) from the start
    Produce high-quality architecture artifacts: solution designs, ADRs, integration specifications,
    architecture standards
  • Define architecture governance practices: what makes a design "good enough to ship" vs what needs
    more work; codify standards the team applies consistently
  • Evaluate and adopt modern architecture patterns and methodologies - not just what Lumen has done,
    but what the broader engineering discipline has learned
  • Apply AI-augmented engineering practices: LLM-assisted design, agentic workflow architecture,
    integrating AI capabilities into system designs safely and observably
  • Architect for operational excellence: observability-first design, chaos engineering readiness,
    runbook-aligned failure handling
  • Bridge the gap between architecture and implementation: stay present through delivery, validate that
    what gets built matches the design intent, surface gaps early
  • Mentor architects and engineers on architecture fundamentals, design patterns, and how to think about
    system design rigorously
  • Partner with cloud, IAM/security, and domain architects to ensure cross-cutting concerns are
    addressed coherently across DJAS's portfolio
  • Challenge technical debt patterns where they emerge in designs - not to block delivery, but to ensure
    the team is making conscious choices

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field with 12+ years of software
    architecture experience or
  • Master's degree with 10+ years of software architecture experience
  • AI-first practitioner - actively integrates AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, AI-powered analysis and
    design tools) as a routine part of architecture and engineering work, not as an occasional experiment.
  • Candidates must demonstrate specific, current examples of how AI has meaningfully accelerated or
    improved their work.
  • Classically trained software architecture background: formal education or structured architecture
    practice exposure (not exclusively developed through a single company's environment)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems: microservices, event-driven architecture, saga patterns, CQRS,
    async messaging
  • API design authority: REST, gRPC, GraphQL - knows when to use each, how to version, how to
    govern
  • Domain-driven design (DDD) and bounded context modeling
  • Non-functional requirements design: performance engineering, reliability patterns (circuit breakers,
    bulkheads, retries), scalability modeling
  • Observability architecture: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, metrics design, distributed tracing, alerting
    standards
  • Security architecture integration: threat modeling, secure design patterns, data classification in
    architecture
  • Strong written and verbal communication: can produce ADRs and solution designs that are clear,
    precise, and decision-quality
  • Track record of delivered production systems - not just designs, but architectures that were built and
    operated

Preferred

  • Experience architecting AI/ML-augmented systems: LLM integration patterns, RAG architecture,
    agentic workflow design
  • Cloud-native architecture depth (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - complements the dedicated Cloud Architect
    role
  • Experience in telecom, network automation, or NaaS domains - reduces ramp time on Lumen-specific
    context
  • Platform architecture experience: designing systems that other teams build on, not just end-user
    applications
  • Architecture governance experience in a multi-team engineering organization: standards enforcement,
    design review processes, exception handling
  • Contributions to technical standards bodies, open source architecture frameworks, or published
    architectural thinking

jobs.description:
Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten.

Jobübersicht

Für unser Technik-Team im Außendienst suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Field Application Engineer (m/w/d) – Electrical / Energietechnik für die Region Bayern und Österreich.

In dieser vielseitigen Position unterstützen Sie unsere Kunden, den Vertrieb sowie interne Fachbereiche bei der technischen Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Energielösungen. Als technische Schnittstelle begleiten Sie Projekte von der Anwendungsberatung über Produktschulungen bis hin zur Entwicklung kundenspezifischer Lösungen und leisten damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Positionierung unseres Produktportfolios.

Dabei bauen Sie Ihre Marktkenntnisse kontinuierlich aus und unterstützen die Entwicklung und Positionierung unserer Lösungen in den Bereichen Nieder-, Mittel- und Hochspannungskabelzubehör, Straßenbeleuchtung, Vergussmaterialien, Anschlusstechnologien der Primärtechnik sowie Anwendungslösungen der Sekundärtechnik.

Es handelt sich um eine Remote-/Home-Office-Position mit regelmäßiger Reisetätigkeit in Bayern, Österreich sowie nach Ottobrunn.

Stellenanforderungen

  • Technische Unterstützung der Vertriebsorganisation bei Kunden im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Durchführung von Produktvorstellungen und praktischen Vorführungen
  • Technische Auslegung und Neuanlage von Produkten gemäß Kundenspezifikationen
  • Erstellung, Pflege und Aktualisierung technischer Produktdokumentationen im Bereich Energy
  • Erstellung von Montageanleitungen und Stücklisten für neue Produkte und Produktmodifikationen
  • Berechnung und Erstellung von Anwendungsbestätigungen für Sonderinstallationen
  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden sowie interne Fachabteilungen
  • Durchführung von Montage- und Produktschulungen in Ottobrunn und direkt beim Kunden
  • Präsentation von Schulungs- und Trainingsunterlagen für interne und externe Zielgruppen
  • Unterstützung von Professional Services und Produktmanagement bei Produktentwicklungen
  • Unterstützung bei Marktbeobachtungen sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Energielösungen

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder Berufserfahrung (z. B. Monteur mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung, Techniker oder Meister)
  • Berufs- und Montageerfahrung mit Kabelgarnituren im Bereich der Nieder-, Mittel- und Hochspannungstechnik
  • Erfahrung mit Anwendungslösungen der Sekundärtechnik, insbesondere im Schaltanlagen- und Stationsbau
  • Professionelles Auftreten und respektvoller Umgang mit Ansprechpartnern auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen
  • Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Entscheidungsträgern aus dem Energieversorgungssektor von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse relevanter Marktstandards und Anforderungen oder die Bereitschaft, sich diese anzueignen
  • Kenntnisse des Produktportfolios von TE Energy sowie des Wettbewerbsumfeldes sind von Vorteil
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, Kundenorientierung und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Belastbarkeit, Flexibilität und Teamfähigkeit
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Bayerns, Österreichs und im Rahmen von Kundenbesuchen und Schulungen vor Ort

Kompetenzen

Werte: Integrität, Verantwortlichkeit, Inklusion, Innovation, Teamarbeit

ÜBER TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) ist ein weltweit führendes Industrie- und Technologieunternehmen, das eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft ermöglicht. Als verlässlicher Innovationspartner entwickelt TE Konnektivitäts- und Sensorlösungen, die die Verteilung und Übertragung von Strom, Signalen und Daten unterstützen und Innovationen in den Bereichen Transport der nächsten Generation, Stromnetze, industrielle Automatisierung, KI-Rechenzentren und vieles mehr vorantreiben. Mit mehr als 90.000 Mitarbeitenden, darunter 10.000 Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, arbeitet TE Seite an Seite mit Kundinnen und Kunden in rund 130 Ländern zusammen. In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Erfahren Sie mehr auf und auf LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram und X (ehemals Twitter).

Was TE Connectivity anbietet:

Wir freuen uns Ihnen ein spannendes Gesamtpaket anbieten zu können, das auch flexibel auf sich wechselnde Lebenssituationen angepasst werden kann – das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter steht an oberster Stelle!

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket
  • Leistungsorientiere Bonuspläne
  • Sport- und Fitnessangebote
  • TE-Aktienkaufprogramm
  • Lokale gemeinnützige Aktionen
  • TE-interne Interessensgruppen (z.B. „Women in Networking“)

We are seeking an experienced WebMethods Platform Administrator to manage, maintain, and support our IBM/Software AG WebMethods integration platform and its associated infrastructure.

This role is responsible for the administration, operation, maintenance, security, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the WebMethods environment across development, test, and production landscapes. The individual will act as the primary technical owner of the platform, ensuring high availability, stability, performance, and compliance with corporate standards.

The position requires strong expertise in middleware administration, server infrastructure, networking, security, troubleshooting, and migration activities, while working closely with integration developers, infrastructure teams, security teams, and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Platform Administration

  • Administer and maintain IBM/Software AG WebMethods environments, including:

    • Integration Server

    • Universal Messaging

    • My WebMethods Server

    • API Gateway

    • Trading Networks

    • Optimize (if applicable)

    • Command Central (if applicable)

  • Manage platform configuration, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

  • Monitor system health, availability, and performance.

Infrastructure & Operations

  • Manage middleware infrastructure across development, QA, UAT, and production environments.

  • Coordinate platform upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and security updates.

  • Perform server provisioning, decommissioning, and lifecycle management.

  • Support infrastructure modernization and migration projects.

Security & Access Management

  • Manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and authentication mechanisms.

  • Coordinate platform security reviews and compliance activities.

  • Implement and maintain SSL certificates, secure communications, and access controls.

  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity teams to address vulnerabilities and remediation plans.

Connectivity & Network Support

  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues involving:

    • Firewalls

    • VPNs

    • Load balancers

    • DNS

    • SSL/TLS

    • Reverse proxies

    • External partner integrations

  • Coordinate with network and infrastructure teams to resolve communication issues between platforms.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Serve as Level 3 support for platform and infrastructure incidents.

  • Analyze logs, diagnostics, and performance metrics to identify root causes.

  • Lead resolution efforts for critical production issues.

  • Participate in on-call support rotations when required.

Platform Monitoring & Logging

  • Configure and maintain monitoring solutions.

  • Analyze application and infrastructure logs.

  • Establish proactive alerting and operational dashboards.

  • Produce operational and availability reports.

Migration & Project Support

  • Lead platform migration projects.

  • Support data center migrations, cloud migrations, and disaster recovery initiatives.

  • Develop deployment and rollback procedures.

  • Maintain platform documentation and operational runbooks.

Governance & Best Practices

  • Define operational standards and administration procedures.

  • Maintain platform documentation and knowledge base.

  • Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.

  • Mentor junior administrators and support teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience administering IBM/Software AG WebMethods environments.

  • Strong knowledge of:

    • Integration Server

    • Universal Messaging

    • API Gateway

    • My WebMethods Server

  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server administration.

  • Experience managing middleware environments in enterprise-scale organizations.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • TCP/IP

    • DNS

    • SSL/TLS

    • Firewalls

    • Load Balancers

    • Reverse Proxies

  • Experience with platform monitoring and log analysis.

  • Experience performing upgrades, migrations, and disaster recovery activities.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or OpenShift.

  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.

  • Experience with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Prometheus.

European Field Service Technical Director

Europe | Pan-European scope | Significant travel across Europe

Location: Europe, home-based with access to a major European travel hub.

Working language: English.

The opportunity

Diversey, a Solenis company, is seeking an established European Field Service leader to transform and strengthen our Technical Service organisation across Europe.

This is a senior pan-European mandate with functional leadership across a large network of several hundred technicians and technical service employees. Working through Country Technical Service Directors and Managers, you will create a more consistent European operating model, strengthen leadership and governance, and improve safety, service quality, customer uptime and operational performance.

Our technicians and service partners install, connect, maintain and repair physical equipment at customer sites. Their work is critical to the safe and uninterrupted operation of our customers’ businesses.

This is an operational line-leadership role rather than a project-only transformation position. Dedicated project resources will support delivery, but you will lead the organisation, define the operating model and embed new ways of working across countries.

What you will do

Lead the European Field Service organisation

  • Provide functional leadership across a large, geographically dispersed European technician and technical-service population.
  • Lead and influence Country Technical Service Directors and Managers within a complex matrix organisation.
  • Establish clear European priorities, standards and accountability while recognising legitimate local requirements.
  • Build a connected leadership community focused on collaboration, capability development and consistent execution.

Transform the operating model

  • Define and implement a practical European Field Service operating model.
  • Harmonise planning, scheduling, dispatch, prioritisation, utilisation and emergency-response practices.
  • Strengthen work-order management, service documentation, performance visibility and consistent use of enterprise systems.
  • Standardise critical processes and governance while ensuring that change is adopted and sustained locally.
  • Translate strategy into practical actions, clear ownership and measurable operational improvement.

Improve service performance

  • Establish meaningful European Field Service KPIs and management routines.
  • Improve safety, service quality, response time, customer uptime, first-time fix, productivity, cost-to-serve and customer satisfaction.
  • Strengthen resource and capacity planning across countries.
  • Create transparent reporting, escalation and corrective-action processes.

Stay connected to customers and technicians

  • Spend time at customer sites with technicians and country service teams.
  • Ensure that European processes work in practice for installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, breakdown response and technical interventions.
  • Use direct operational insight to remove barriers, improve working practices and build credibility with the Field Service community.

Lead internal and external service capacity

  • Align internal technicians and third-party technical service providers within one European model.
  • Strengthen partner selection, qualification, onboarding, training and performance management.
  • Establish consistent governance covering safety, technical capability, quality, service levels, cost and escalation.
  • Develop external service capacity where additional geographic coverage or specialist capability is required.

What you will bring

  • Significant senior leadership experience in Field Service, Technical Service, After-Sales, Customer Engineering or a closely comparable technical service organisation.
  • Proven responsibility across multiple European countries or another complex international region.
  • Experience leading managers and a substantial, geographically dispersed population of technicians or service engineers.
  • Direct leadership experience in a customer-site environment involving the installation, maintenance and repair of physical equipment.
  • Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance, technical troubleshooting, service response, safety and customer-site delivery.
  • Credibility with technicians and Field Service leaders, developed through direct technical or operational experience and regular exposure to customer-site operations.
  • Evidence of personally transforming how a Field Service or Technical Service organisation operates through line leadership.
  • Experience standardising processes, strengthening governance, implementing KPIs and embedding systems and new ways of working.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior country leaders and deliver change through a matrix.
  • Experience governing contractors, authorised service organisations, distributors or technical service partners.
  • A strong service culture and an understanding of how responsiveness, uptime, safety, quality and cost-to-serve affect customer operations and business performance.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Europe.

Additional experience that would be advantageous

  • Experience in hygiene, dosing systems, warewashing, commercial laundry, foodservice equipment or another comparable customer-site service environment.
  • Experience in lifts and elevators, industrial machinery, automation, HVAC, building systems, medical or laboratory equipment, water treatment, packaging or similar installed-equipment sectors.
  • Experience leading both direct technical teams and outsourced service networks.
  • P&L, service-budget or cost-management responsibility.
  • Experience implementing Field Service Management, CRM, ERP, work-order or workforce-planning systems.
  • Professional capability in another European language.

Is this the right opportunity for you?

  • This role requires an established European Field Service leader who has already led managers, sizeable technical populations and meaningful operational change.
  • Experience centred primarily on Customer Service, sales, PMO or transformation programmes, software support, product engineering, helpdesks or internal plant maintenance will not be sufficient unless it is accompanied by directly comparable customer-site Field Service leadership at scale.
  • You will be comfortable moving between strategy and operations: setting a European direction, influencing country leaders, visiting customer sites and ensuring that change works for the technicians and customers it affects.

Why join us?

  • A high-impact European mandate with visible sponsorship and genuine transformation scope.
  • The opportunity to shape how a major technical service population works across countries, internal teams and external partners.
  • Direct influence on customer uptime, safety, service quality, operational performance and retention.
  • A dynamic international environment within a global organisation committed to sustainability, innovation and customer value.

jobs.title: Manager, Data Platform Governance & Operations
jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


About the Role

The Manager, Data Platform Governance & Operations is the strategic and operational leader of enterprise data governance, responsible for building and scaling governance infrastructure across Snowflake, AWS, and emerging data platforms. You will lead a small, high-performing team that includes senior engineers, oversee compliance and cost strategy, and partner with platform, engineering, and business teams to enable governed, self-service data access at scale.

This role bridges governance policy, platform engineering, and organizational leadership.

You will own the vision and execution of a code-first governance discipline, establish data governance culture, manage platform economics, and lead hiring and mentorship of technical talent. Success means embedding governance as an enabler, not a blocker, across hundreds of internal and external data consumers.

Key Collaborators: Data Engineering, Data Governance, SOX, AI/ML teams

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Governance & Platform Leadership

  • Define and evolve the enterprise data governance strategy, including RBAC patterns, compliance frameworks, cost optimization, and AI/ML data governance maturity roadmap
  • Own the Snowflake and AWS platform governance architecture, ensuring security, compliance, cost efficiency, and self-service enablement across environments
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to embed governance capabilities (RBAC, network security, data masking, Iceberg integration) into Snowflake, AWS, Athena, and emerging platforms
  • Establish governance foundations for AI/ML initiatives, including Snowflake Cortex model governance, data lineage for AI pipelines, responsible data use policies, and Snowpark ML asset management

Governance Operations & Compliance

  • Operationalize enterprise data governance standards through automation, policies, and controls across Snowflake and AWS platforms
  • Own SOX compliance execution, including access controls, audit evidence generation, segregation-of-duties monitoring, and continuous compliance validation
  • Manage data catalog operations and metadata governance, ensuring accurate lineage, PII tagging, data masking policies, and stewardship practices across domains
  • Monitor governance adherence and compliance posture through automated reporting, anomaly detection, and visibility dashboards

Platform Economics & Cost Strategy

  • Own Snowflake and AWS platform cost management, including warehouse sizing strategy, compute optimization, cost attribution models, and chargeback frameworks
  • Establish cost observability through resource monitors, query tagging, and governance-driven cost reduction initiatives
  • Measure and report on platform ROI, governance impact (audit reduction, compliance velocity), and cost trends to leadership

Team Leadership, Hiring & Organizational Development

  • Build and mentor a high-performing governance team, including hiring senior technical talent, defining career paths, and fostering a culture of continuous learning
  • Partner with team members on platform architecture decisions, code reviews, and technical problem-solving
  • Establish scalable governance practices that enable the team to grow from 3 to 5 engineers to support emerging organizational needs

Self-Service Enablement & Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of governed data products and self-service access models across the organization
  • Support onboarding of new teams and data domains through standardized governance patterns and best practices
  • Manage cross-functional relationships with Data Engineering, Security, Finance, and business stakeholders to ensure governance decisions align with platform roadmap and organizational priorities

What You Bring

Required Leadership Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data governance, data platform operations, or data management, with 3+ years in a people leadership or technical lead role
  • Track record building and scaling governance programs in cloud-based environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical teams, with experience in hiring, performance management, and organizational development

Required Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of Snowflake platform architecture, including RBAC design (functional vs. access roles), row-level security, data masking, network policies, authentication policies, resource optimization, and cost controls
  • AWS cloud proficiency, including S3, IAM, governance integrations, and multi-engine data architectures (Iceberg, Athena, Spark)
  • Enterprise compliance experience (SOX, SOC 2, or equivalent); expertise in access controls, audit evidence, and continuous compliance automation
  • Data catalog and metadata management expertise (Alation, Collibra, or similar); ability to design and oversee stewardship practices
  • Knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks) and governance capabilities such as cataloging, lineage, and access control

Preferred Expertise

  • Snowflake AI/ML governance: Experience with Cortex, Agents, Snowpark ML, and establishing governance for AI data pipelines
  • Platform economics: Experience with cost attribution, chargeback models, and ROI measurement for data platform investments
  • Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform or equivalent for governance automation and enforcement
  • Enterprise SaaS environment: Experience in organizations with distributed data ownership, self-service models, and rapid scaling

Core Competencies

  • Data Governance & Compliance Strategy
  • Snowflake & AWS Platform Architecture
  • Team Leadership, Hiring & Mentorship
  • Data Catalog & Metadata Management
  • Platform Economics & Cost Optimization
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
  • AI/ML Data Governance
  • Servant Leadership & Organizational Development

Why You Will Succeed Here

  • Lead from principles: Servant leadership and empathy matter here. You will mentor technical talent and build a collaborative governance team.
  • Strategic influence: Governance decisions directly shape platform roadmap, cost efficiency, and organizational data culture.
  • Emerging technology: Work with Snowflake AI, multi-engine architectures, and data platforms at the frontier of innovation.
  • Scaling impact: Build governance infrastructure that serves thousands of internal and external data consumers.
  • Organizational growth: Hire, mentor, and grow the team as governance maturity and adoption expand.

Business Impact

  • Transforms governance from manual, audit-driven practice to a scalable, code-first discipline that reduces risk and accelerates innovation
  • Reduces security, compliance, and cost risks through standardized governance controls, continuous validation, and cost transparency
  • Enables self-service data access with built-in controls, accelerating analytics and AI initiatives while maintaining security guardrails
  • • Optimizes platform economics through cost controls, resource efficiency, and data-driven investment decisions

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Reporting to the Global Mobility Leader, the Global Mobility Analyst is responsible for supporting the administration, coordination, governance, and continuous improvement of Veralto’s global mobility and U.S. domestic relocation programs.

This position is part of the Global Mobility team and can be performed remotely from anywhere in Mexico, supporting associates and stakeholders across Veralto's global organization.

This role supports the execution of Veralto’s Global Mobility strategy, policies, and processes across the full mobility lifecycle, including business approval, relocation or assignment initiation, vendor coordination, transfer monitoring, compliance tracking, reporting, and assignment completion. The Global Mobility Analyst partners closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Travel, HR Services, operating company stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver a consistent, compliant, and employee-centered mobility experience.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Support the administration of global mobility programs, including international assignments, permanent transfers, cross-border arrangements, and U.S. domestic relocations from initiation through completion.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Legal, Tax, Payroll, Finance, Travel, operating company stakeholders, mobility vendors, and associates to deliver a seamless mobility experience.

  • Prepare and maintain mobility reporting, dashboards, tracking tools, compliance summaries, relocation spend reports, and management updates.
  • Develop and maintain mobility resources, including process maps, policy summaries, FAQs, stakeholder guides, training materials, and SharePoint content.
  • Identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, technology adoption, and continuous improvement to strengthen governance and simplify the mobility experience.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Accounting, Global Mobility, or a related field, or equivalent progressive experience.
  • Three to five years of experience in global mobility, relocation, international assignments, immigration, tax, payroll, compensation, HR operations, or related consulting within a multinational organization.

  • Fluency in English required. Spanish or additional languages are a plus.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Introduction

The Office of Information Services (OIS) is a shared service provider for the Oregon Health Authority (OHA) and Oregon Department of Human Services (ODHS). OIS provides the technology systems and services that support more than 18,000 OHA and ODHS agency staff at local offices and facilities around Oregon. These systems and services help the two agencies determine client service program eligibility; provide medical, housing, food, and job assistance; provide addiction, mental health, vocational and rehabilitative services; protect children, seniors and people with physical and/or developmental disabilities; process claims and benefits; manage provider licensing and Oregon hospital facilities; and promote and protect the Oregon public health.

The Office of Developmental Disabilities Services (ODDS) is a program of the Department of Human Services in coordination with the Oregon Health Authority. ODDS is refining Oregon's developmental disabilities system to be more person-centered through the DD Case Management and Provider Enrollment Management Project. eXPRS is a web-based system developed to manage long term care Medicaid services for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). The project has already improved some aspects of the system such as the Oregon Needs Assessment — a flexible and universal tool to collect information about what each individual needs.

OIS seeks an experiencedSenior Developerto support further development, enhancement, and improvement to the eXPRS application.

Scope of Work:

Contractor’s Key Person under this WOC will support the following needs of the Operations and Maintenance of the ODHS/ODDS eXPRS application:

  • Assist with identification and remediation of application bugs
  • Assist with the completion of operational requests in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Assist with the completion of the application enhancement request in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Assist with completion of the performance and maintenance requests in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Assist with the completion of the application refactoring requests in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Assist with the completion of the User Interface improvement requests in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Assist with the completion of the data and reporting requests in the eXPRS ADOS Backlog
  • Transition of the concepts and enhancements to existing team members to enable them to provide ongoing support

Tasks:

  • Contractor’s Key Person shalldevelop and deliver updates to eXPRS application, including software code changes and documentation.
  • Work will be comprised of the following:
  • Documenting completed enhancements to ensure complete system documentation for the eXPRS application.
  • Completing defect and change requests for code modifications associated with the Services that impact the eXPRS application.
  • Engaging in multiple discussions with system and business experts as well as attending daily Scrum meetings.
  • Engaging with the ODHS business product owner to understand mandatory functional business requirements and timelines.
  • Documenting solution options, impacted system areas, system dependencies, and gaps in system capabilities needed to fulfill requirements.
  • Engaging with the ODHS project technical architect to understand technical standards, and documenting technical design.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.excerpt: About Feeld:Feeld is a dating app created intentionally for a community of authentic and open-minded humans seeking connection in a way that allows each member to come as they are.
jobs.description:
About Feeld:

Feeld is a dating app created intentionally for a community of authentic and open-minded humans seeking connection in a way that allows each member to come as they are. Founded by designers, we believe that the "uncomfortable" can be made beautiful through intentional, elegant design. We provide a sanctuary for exploration, where human intimacy is treated with the artistry it deserves.

As societal norms shift and what was once considered "alternative" becomes part of the cultural zeitgeist, Feeld is evolving too. We aren't just keeping pace with changing norms; we are actively designing the frameworks that will define the future of human connection.

The Opportunity

Feeld has built one of the most culturally significant brands in the dating space. We have a massive, loyal community and a unique market position that our competitors cannot replicate. As we enter our next era, we are looking for our first-ever Chief Product Officer to take the reins of our product ecosystem and match our technical execution to our brand’s massive cultural ambition.

This is a defining role for the company. The CPO will not just manage our current product; they will be tasked with imagining the product for the existing and future needs of our communities and society. You will create a cohesive, intuitive, and beautifully designed product that members genuinely love by unifying vision, strategy, and execution across Product, Design, and Data in close partnership with Engineering.

This role requires both visionary leadership and practical engagement: the ability to map out where human intimacy is heading over the next decade, while simultaneously going deep into the weeds to evaluate what’s working, what isn’t, and why.

In short: You will be the architect of a new era of "Product-Led Excellence" at Feeld, turning progressive human values into a world-class digital experience.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy, and Societal Foresight

  • Anticipate the Future of Connection: Define and communicate a clear product point of view that anticipates macro societal shifts in relationships, intimacy, and community.
  • Multi-Year Roadmap: Build and execute a cohesive, multi-year product roadmap that unifies brand, design, and technical initiatives into a single, high-impact system.
  • Outcome-Driven Focus: Shift the organization from feature-led delivery to outcome-driven product development, ensuring work is focused on meaningful member moments, engagement, and retention.
  • Drive Coherence: Bring clarity where experiences feel fragmented, simplifying complexity and reducing friction across the end-to-end user journey.

Customer Obsession as a Living Practice

  • Direct Observation: Establish consistent, first-hand connection to members through direct observation, research, and qualitative insight to understand how their real-world needs are changing.
  • Deep Pain-Point Discovery: Shift discovery from feature ideation toward deep pain-point understanding, including identifying subtle and silent friction in the experience.
  • Community-First Culture: Foster a user-first culture where teams understand the emotional and functional realities of our diverse members, particularly women, LGBTQ+ communities, and non-monogamous people.
  • Translate Truths to Product: Convert deep member insights into prioritized, elegant product and design solutions that actually ship.

Craft, Quality, and Design Excellence

  • Uphold the Bar: Set a world-class standard for usability, aesthetics, and interaction quality across the product.
  • Make the Uncomfortable Beautiful: Partner deeply with Design to ensure Feeld remains visually, emotionally, and experientially distinct in the category.
  • Resolve Experience Friction: Act as a relentless steward of the overall experience, identifying and resolving persistent UX hurdles that limit member joy.
  • Deliberate Differentiation: Balance industry-standard expectations with visionary differentiation, knowing exactly where Feeld should follow industry conventions and where we must lead.

Execution, Systems, and Operating Model

  • Operational Alignment: Lead effective prioritization, planning, and decision-making across Product, Design, Data, and Engineering.
  • Velocity & Craft: Increase delivery speed and confidence while fiercely protecting product quality, user trust, and design craft.
  • Cross-Functional Clarity: Create absolute alignment across Engineering, Marketing, and Leadership regarding product priorities and the strategic rationale behind them.

Hands-on Evaluation and Informed Leadership

  • In-the-Weeds Understanding: Engage directly with the product and delivery processes to build first-hand understanding of technical constraints, strengths, and gaps.
  • Assess and Evolve: Work closely with Product and Design leadership to assess execution effectiveness and focus teams on the highest-leverage work.

Trust, Safety, and Integrity as Product Principles

  • Foundational Trust: Treat trust, safety, privacy, and respectful interaction as core product responsibilities, not an afterthought.
  • Systems Thinking for Safety: Ensure ethical and safety concerns are addressed through thoughtful product design, progressive systems thinking, and ongoing iteration.

Growth, Monetization, and Value Exchange

  • Experience-Led Growth: Improve activation, engagement, and conversion through product improvements that solve real member problems.
  • Ethical Monetization: Balance business outcomes with long-term relationships, ensuring monetization model decisions align with Feeld’s progressive brand and values.

AI as a Force Multiplier

  • Responsible Innovation: Develop a clear framework for how Feeld leverages AI to accelerate discovery, design, and delivery while maintaining strict member privacy and safety boundaries.

Key Objectives

  1. Elevate and Cohere the Experience: Create a product that feels intuitive, seamless, and emotionally resonant, closing the gap between Feeld’s high-concept brand and its day-to-day app experience.
  2. Future-Proof the Product: Successfully position the app to serve the next generation of users by creating features that accommodate fluid relationship structures and changing social norms.
  3. Drive Sustained Retention: Achieve measurable, long-term improvements in engagement and retention by solving real member problems.
  4. Establish Organizational Focus: Institutionalize a unified roadmap with clear priorities, shifting the company culture toward regular member observation, outcomes, and high-standard design craft.

Benefits

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at .

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • A fully remote working situation
  • Home office budget
  • Learning & development budget
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill
  • In-person meet ups

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable. Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

Given the seniority of the Chief Product Officer role and the geographical diversity of our team across the US, Canada, and the UK, we provide tailored, competitive, and equitable compensation packages. We are committed to transparency and will discuss specific compensation details during our first conversation.

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
  • Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
  • The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

To find out more about Feeld, download our app (available on iOS and Android).

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Our work is guided by our core values: customer first, safety always, operational excellence and one team. These values shape how we make decisions, support each other and deliver for the people who count on us.

Support for work, life and travel

Frontier offers benefits, programs and travel privileges designed to support eligible employees at work and beyond. Availability may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, location, schedule, applicable policies and current plan details.

Depending on role and eligibility, available benefits and programs may include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage

Frontier Airlines is a Denver-based airline serving destinations across the United States and select international markets. Our people support every part of the travel journey, from airport operations and flight crews to aircraft maintenance, customer support, corporate teams and more.

We’re focused on delivering meaningful value by making travel more accessible, practical and easy to personalize for our customers. Across the airline, our teams help support a safe, reliable and efficient operation while continuing to strengthen the experience for the people who choose Frontier.

  • 35% - Partner Delivery, Vendor Governance & Operational Performance

    • Lead operational readiness activities for product launches, policy changes, process updates, system or tool changes, seasonal volume increases, IROPs, and customer-impacting incidents.
    • Coordinate cross-functional communication, contingency planning, partner execution, risk documentation, and mitigation plans during high-volume or high-risk events.
    • Partner with Workforce, Quality, Training, and Knowledge Management teams to ensure partner teams have the capacity, coaching, guidance, and documentation needed to support customers effectively.
  • 15% - Business Insights, Root Cause & Continuous Improvement

Appointment Scheduling and Care Coordination

Care Workflow Support

What You Bring

jobs.excerpt: ICF seeks an experienced Bilingual Early Childhood (EC) Specialist to support Head Start and Early Head Start programs to ensure high quality Head Start and Early Head Start services in accordance with federal regulations.
jobs.description:
ICF seeks an experienced Bilingual Early Childhood (EC) Specialist to support Head Start and Early Head Start programs to ensure high quality Head Start and Early Head Start services in accordance with federal regulations. The EC will provide training and technical assistance (TTA) to programs to support progress toward established school readiness goals, focusing on the use of child and program data to make decisions about approaches to working with teachers, home visitors, and parents in quality practices. The EC will provide professional-level expertise by engaging programs in dialogue and learning of best practices for children from birth to five and encourage a culture of learning that promotes school readiness.

This position is home-based in one of the following states (Delaware, Washington, D.C., Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and West Virginia), and extensive travel within those states, and other parts of the country as needed, will be required to fulfill the duties of the position. This position also requires a candidate who is bilingual in Spanish and English.

Basic Qualifications

The EC shall have:

  • A minimum of a BA or BS degree in Early Childhood Education/Development or a related field from an accredited college or university.
  • If the highest degree was awarded more than ten years ago, the resume should specifically detail courses, conferences, seminars attended or relevant work experience that ensure the proposed candidate remains current in the field of early childhood development.
  • Must be fluently bilingual. Must be able to read, write, and speak in Spanish and English
  • 5+ years' experience in programs for young children ranging from birth to five years in age. The experience should include the provision of technical assistance to teachers, home visitors, family childcare providers, coaches, and/or management team members.
  • 1+ year experience working with infants and toddlers
  • 1+ year experience of Family engagement experience
  • 1+ year experience facilitating group discussions and presenting to range of audiences.
  • 1+ year experience analyzing data and assisting programs to make data driven decisions.
  • 1+ year experience providing training and/or technical assistance to programs in developing and/or implementing school readiness goals or plans.
  • 1+ year experience communicating, both orally and in writing, to various audiences.

Preferred Experience/Skills

  • Knowledge of Head Start
  • Experience working within a Head Start Program

Key Responsibilities

The Regional EC shall provide the following in-person or virtually as determined by the regional office.

  • Provide TTA to programs related to school readiness, family engagement, and professional development.
  • Provide TTA related to the selection and implementation of ongoing child assessment, curriculum, and teaching that is age, developmentally, culturally, and linguistically appropriate across the birth to five spectrum.
  • Assist programs to improve teacher/child interactions as described by the Classroom Assessment Scoring System (CLASS) for center-based preschool programs and other measures suitable for programs serving children from birth-to-five or children in home based and family childcare settings.
  • Assist programs to develop the procedures and skills to aggregate, analyze, and use data obtained through multiple sources.
  • Assist programs to implement a research-based coaching model.
  • Assist programs to develop and implement family engagement practices that support family progress as described in the Parent Family and Community Engagement (PFCE) Framework, including coaching of family engagement staff and selection and implementation of a parenting curriculum.

The Contract and Litigation Paralegal provides substantive legal and administrative support across multiple functions, including contract lifecycle management and litigation support.   • Working knowledge of civil procedures, e-discovery tools (e.g., DocuSign).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Adobe Acrobat; comfortable learning new legal technology platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced legal environment.
  • Notary Public certification a plus.

Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

The Opportunity

Galderma seeks an experienced compliance investigator and monitoring specialist to take a leadership role in the continuous development of Galderma’s U.S. Investigations and Monitoring program. The Associate Director, Compliance Investigations & Monitoring will report directly to the Head of U.S. Compliance and will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing the day-to-day operation of the investigations and monitoring program. This role is integral to the organization and serves as a key member of the Ethics & Compliance team, helping to drive a robust speak-up culture, proactive risk identification, and effective remediation.

Key Responsibilities

Lead U.S. Compliance Investigations (50%)

  • Expected outcomes: Timely, consistent, fair, well-documented investigations, appropriate conclusions, root-cause considerations, and actionable remediation recommendations.

  • How performed: Own program framework; coordinate with HR, Legal, and key partners; set intake, triage, scoping, documentation, and closure standards; conduct investigations (data review, interviews, evidence assessment); lead investigations readouts with senior leadership; recommend remediation.

  • How performed: Independently handle varied-complexity matters; partner with Compliance Business Partners and cross-functional stakeholders to interpret policies and implement remediation (policy updates, training, coaching, enhanced monitoring).

Develop Investigations Program (procedures, documentation, and training) (15%)

  • Expected outcomes: Standardized, scalable investigations capability across involved functions; improved consistency and defensibility of case files.

  • How performed: Establish operating procedures and protocols aligned with Code of Conduct/global standards; develop templates and guidance; train cross-functional colleagues on investigations process, documentation, and case management expectations.

Design and continuously improve U.S. compliance monitoring program (20%)

  • Expected outcomes: Risk-based monitoring coverage of high-risk activities; early detection of issues and prevention of repeat findings.

  • How performed: Build and execute monitoring plans (field rides; speaker programs; advisory boards; trainings; congresses; in-market promotional/educational events); refine methodologies and sampling.

  • Identify areas of emerging risks, anomalies, and trends to prioritize areas for transactional and data-driven monitoring and analytics

Reporting, dashboards, governance alignment, and continuous improvement (15%)

  • Expected outcomes: Clear leadership visibility into metrics, trends, and remediation progress; alignment with global E&C expectations.

  • How performed: Develop dashboards/reporting packages; deliver periodic monitoring reports to leadership/committees; support targeted reviews; promote strong ethics and compliance culture.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) or in-house compliance investigations experience at a pharmaceutical or medical device company.

  • 8-12 years of experience advising a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences company on compliance matters (in-house or law firm).

  • Significant experience conducting internal compliance investigations and managing investigations programs (intake, triage, case handling, reporting, remediation).

  • Expertise and significant experience advising on U.S. healthcare compliance for prescription products and devices.

  • Deep knowledge of pharmaceutical industry regulations and therapeutic areas, and of laws/regulations/industry guidance relevant to commercialization (including Federal Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, FDCA, OIG/DOJ guidance, PhRMA Code, U.S. state and local marketing compliance laws, and relevant enforcement actions).

  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing monitoring programs and activities, including field-based monitoring and data-driven analytics.

  • Strong commercial acumen and understanding of market dynamics and business culture impacts.

  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills (large datasets, trend identification, “big picture”).

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills; effective with senior leadership and stakeholders at all levels.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex matters in a fast-paced environment; strong project management and organizational skills.

  • Ability to handle confidential information appropriately and exercise sound judgment on sensitive investigations and monitoring matters.

  • Demonstrated strong commitment to compliance, ethics, and accountability.

  • Ability to travel up to 30%.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

This role requires the ability to perform standard office activities, including extended periods of computer use, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and collaboration across teams. Depending on business needs, occasional travel may be required. Work environments and physical requirements may vary based on the requirements of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Duties and responsibilities may be modified, added, or removed as necessary to meet business and organizational needs.

Compensation

Where pay falls withing the range may vary based on many factors, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, skills, experience, education, certifications, location and applicable geographic pay zones, market conditions, internal equity and business considerations. Work Authorization

What We Offer

We offer competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, along with meaningful opportunities for growth, development, and collaboration in an inclusive and innovative environment.
