jobs.description:
MinIO is the industry leader in high-performance object storage and the company behind the world’s fastest, most widely deployed object store, powering production infrastructure for more than half of the Fortune 500, including 9 of the 10 largest global automakers and all 10 of the largest U.S. banks. Our enterprise offering, AIStor, is engineered to handle the scale, speed, and pressure of modern AI and analytics, from terabytes to exabytes, all in a single namespace.

The Director, Product Marketing - Analytics Partners will play a pivotal role in shaping how MinIO is positioned within the Databricks ecosystem and the broader hybrid analytics and AI landscape. This role combines deep fluency in the modern data lakehouse, Delta Sharing, and open table formats with hands-on product marketing ownership of MinIO's most strategic data platform partnership. You will be responsible for understanding how AIStor Table Sharing extends Databricks to on-premises data, and translating that knowledge into differentiated messaging, joint content, and go to market strategies that resonate with data and AI leaders, platform engineers, and the Databricks field teams selling alongside us.

You will collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Alliances, Corporate Development, and counterparts at Databricks to craft and deliver the narratives that position AIStor as the data platform that unlocks on-premises data for Databricks. Every on-premises table connected through AIStor is a new workload running on Databricks compute, and this role owns the messaging that makes that commercial story land with Databricks account teams and end customers alike.

What You Will Do:

  • Databricks Partnership Narrative: Own the messaging and content that defines MinIO's role in the Databricks ecosystem across AIStor Table Sharing, Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, Apache Iceberg™, and Delta Lake. Translate joint engineering work and architectural integration into co-marketing assets, reference architecture content, and customer-facing narratives that position Databricks as the hero with AIStor as the enabling data platform. Navigate across Product and Marketing across both companies to ensure that MinIO features and capabilities are tied to the newest capabilities and offerings from Databricks.
  • Executive Presence: Be the face of MinIO's marketing efforts for the Databricks partnership, representing the joint story at industry events, on webinars, in analyst briefings, and in executive conversations with Databricks and customer leadership.
  • Hybrid Analytics Positioning: Develop the technical and business positioning for AIStor Table Sharing as the bridge between on-premises data and Databricks cloud compute. Make the case for zero-copy, in-place data sharing as a required capability for enterprises with data sovereignty, time sensitivity, or scale constraints that keep critical datasets on-premises.
  • Cross-Audience Translation: Translate value across the seam between infrastructure and data teams, the two organizations that own the buying decision but don't always speak the same language. Build messaging that helps storage and infrastructure leaders bring a tangible win to their data team counterparts, and vice versa, and that gives Databricks AEs and MinIO reps a co-sell motion that covers both sides of the customer organization.
  • Partner Co-Marketing: Partner with Databricks marketing, product, and field teams to plan and execute joint launches, joint content, joint events, and co-branded technical assets. Align launch cadence and messaging with Databricks roadmap milestones and major moments like Databricks Data + AI Summit. Build durable co-marketing programs that drive pipeline for both companies.
  • Solutions Marketing for Vertical Use Cases: Build solutions content for the verticals where regulated or high-gravity on-premises data meets active Databricks footprint. Primary focus on financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, and federal and public sector. Expansion into telecommunications, retail, automotive, and energy and utilities as the partnership matures. Each vertical becomes a defensible, field-ready story anchored in real customer outcomes.
  • Field Enablement for Joint Selling: Build and deliver the enablement content (battlecards, talk tracks, customer presentations, technical briefs, one-pagers) that lets MinIO sellers and Databricks AEs, Solutions Architects, Partner Solutions Architects, and Field CTOs confidently co-sell into hybrid analytics opportunities. Articulate the joint commercial value for Databricks account teams: every on-premises table unlocked through AIStor is net-new Databricks compute consumption.
  • Product Launch Execution: Drive the GTM strategy and execution for AIStor releases that touch the Databricks ecosystem. Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Field, Sales including Channel Partners, and Communications to land launches that move pipeline and resonate across our technical champions and buyer personas.
  • BDR and Demand Generation Support: Partner with the BDR team to build outbound sequences, post-event follow-up programs, and inbound nurture tracks targeting Databricks-centric accounts. Equip the funnel with the right messaging at every stage.

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, with at least 3 years focused on data platforms, analytics, lakehouse architectures, or strategic partner marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience driving partner co-marketing programs with strategic technology partners such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud, or other major data and cloud platforms.
  • Strong technical acumen on lakehouse architecture, open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg™), data sharing protocols, and the modern data and AI stack. Fluent enough to engage credibly with Databricks product and field teams and with technical buyers at customer accounts.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for both economic buyers (CIO, CDO, CTO, CISO, VP of Data and Analytics) and technical champions (Director of Data Engineering, Principal Data Architect, Databricks Platform Owner, Lead Data Engineer).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating sales enablement content and customer-facing materials. Tight, prose-forward copy. No reliance on bullet-heavy formatting where prose works better.
  • Track record of executing high-stakes product launches with cross-functional coordination across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and external partners.
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.
  • Direct experience working with or alongside Databricks, including familiarity with Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Mosaic AI, or the broader Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Apache Iceberg™, Delta Lake, and the open lakehouse ecosystem, including catalog technologies and table format interoperability.
  • Background that includes time in technical roles (engineering, solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or developer relations) or in data and analytics functions.
  • Familiarity with MinIO, S3-compatible storage, or high-performance object storage for AI and analytics workloads.
  • Experience marketing into regulated industries (financial services, federal, healthcare) where data sovereignty and on-premises data gravity shape buying decisions.
  • Experience marketing to North American enterprises required. Familiarity with EU and UK enterprise data sovereignty considerations a plus, with the ability to calibrate tone for understated, factual European market communication.

What We Offer:

  • 401K with 3% Contribution

You’ll find opportunities to improve how provider operations work, then turn those insights into product experiences that increase clarity, build trust, reduce manual effort, and support adoption.

This role reports to the Head of Design. Base compensation for this role may land between $150,000 and $200,000. Responsibilities

Mindset

  • Craft-minded: You believe quality, clarity, and interaction details are how customers build trust in the product.
  • Systems-oriented: You look beyond the screen in front of you and design patterns that can scale.
  • Outcome-driven: You care whether the work improves adoption, trust, efficiency, retention, or customer confidence.
  • Modern in practice: You use AI, prototyping, data, and technical tools to learn faster, test ideas earlier, and ship better product.

Requirements

jobs.excerpt: A New Paradigm For Space Operations. Who We Are:Space Kinetic is a dual use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations – one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low-cost, operationally flexible, attainable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem's reliance on consumable fuel.
jobs.description:
A New Paradigm For Space Operations.

Who We Are:

Space Kinetic is a dual use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations – one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low-cost, operationally flexible, attainable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem's reliance on consumable fuel. In a world where many companies are focused on incrementally improving the status quo, we are focused on creating something entirely different – an architecture underpinned by new first principles to meet the opportunities and challenges of the third space age head-on. Our goal is to move away from one-to-one space architectures – where each satellite in a constellation has one (or a small # of) primary payloads attached to the bus -- and unlock a ‘one-to-many’ system, where each satellite has a large number of payloads which can be deployed from their host spacecraft at high velocities without firing a thruster.

This is not a role for someone looking for a traditional 40-hour work week. Space Kinetic is building ambitious, first-of-its-kind technology, and that requires urgency, ownership, and a high level of commitment to changing the foundational assumptions for everything we do in space.

What You’ll Do:

As a Proposal Writer at Space Kinetic, you will play a critical role in securing the partnerships, contracts, and funding that power our mission. You will lead the development of high‑quality proposals for government agencies, commercial customers, and strategic partners: translating complex technical concepts into compelling, clear, and compliant narratives. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, engineering, and business development, offering a unique opportunity to shape how our technology is understood and adopted by the market.

This is a full-time position that can either be worked onsite at the El Segundo office or remote.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end proposal development, from opportunity analysis and outline creation to final submission for government (e.g.,DoD, SBIR, NASA) and commercial customers.
  • Craft persuasive, technically accurate content that clearly communicates our mission, capabilities, solutions, and value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and strategy teams to translate technical inputs into polished narratives, graphics, and structured proposal components.
  • Ensure full compliance with RFP/RFI/BAA requirements, including format, structure, evaluation criteria, and submission protocols.
  • Manage proposal timelines and workflows, including content collection, technical reviews, color-team reviews, and final production.
  • Develop reusable proposal assets, including boilerplate text, past performance summaries, capability statements, and standard graphics.

What It Takes:

  • Bachelor's degree in Writing, Engineering, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in proposal writing, technical writing, or government contracting—preferably in aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, or similar industries.
  • Strong understanding of government procurement processes, including FAR-based solicitations, SBIR/STTR programs, and OTA or commercial contracting pathways.
  • Ability to synthesize complex, highly technical information into clear, concise, and engaging content.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Experience with proposal tools and templates (e.g., color reviews, compliance matrices, proposal outlines).
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities.
  • Eligible to hold a US TS/SCI Clearance

What We’d Love:

  • Previous work on Large-scale IDIQ, BAA, FOA, or SBIR Phase II/III proposals.
  • Understanding of classified program workflows
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.
  • Experience creating visual storytelling assets, such as graphics, infographics, or data visualizations.

Where You’ll Be:

  • The position can be onsite in El Segundo, CA or worked remotely.

What We Offer:

  • Equity-Based Compensation
  • Highly Competitive PTO and Holiday Calendar
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Unique Performance-Based Bonus Structure

ITAR Requirements: 
This position is subject to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Candidates must be a U.S. Person (this includes U.S. Citizen, Permanent Resident, Protected Individual as defined by law), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about ITAR here

Equal Employment Opportunity:
Space Kinetic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran status, disabilityor any other legally protected status.

The annual base salary for this role is below. Pay Grades are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data.  Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education/experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and internal equity.

jobs.excerpt: The Reality of the RoleMost Enterprise AE roles provide you with a territory, an SDR team, and a well-worn playbook.
jobs.description:
The Reality of the Role

Most Enterprise AE roles provide you with a territory, an SDR team, and a well-worn playbook. This is not that role. Springboard is partnering with health systems to solve one of healthcare's most urgent problems: the workforce pipeline. We help employers become talent makers, not talent takers, designing and delivering training programs that produce certified, job-ready talent. It's a differentiated model (customers pay for completers, not seats) and a complex sell. This is not a product-in-a-box role. You will:

  • Own the Full Lifecycle: From cold outreach and "top-down" prospecting to ink-on-paper at the IDN/Health System level.
  • Navigate the C-Suite: Lead multi-stakeholder deals (6–18 month cycles) involving COOs, CHROs, and CEOs.
  • Architect the Solution: This isn’t a "product-in-a-box." You’ll collaborate with our Learning Design and Leadership teams to tailor solutions that solve specific clinical and operational gaps.
  • Iterate on the Fly: When a pitch fails, you don't wait for Marketing to fix it. You diagnose the gap, adjust the business case, and try again.

You're probably right for this if:

  • You've closed complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals and you genuinely liked the process, not just the close.
  • You've worked in an environment without a lot of structure and created structure rather than complained about its absence.
  • You've had to say "here's how we should position this" and had the credibility to support it.
  • You think in outcomes and ROI, not features.
  • You've been told you're relentless, and enjoyed the compliment.

Healthcare background is a plus. What's non-negotiable is business acumen, stamina, and a sense of urgency.

You're probably not right for this if:

  • You need a warm inbound pipeline to get going.
  • You prefer a defined role over a builder role.
  • You're energized by working a system rather than building one.
  • You want predictability over ownership.

Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years in Enterprise Sales, ideally selling complex services or high-ACV services into Health Systems.
  • Strategic Acumen: Ability to build a business case that moves the needle for a CFO or Chief People Officer.
  • Resilience: A proven track record of navigating long, bureaucratic sales cycles without losing momentum.
  • Communication: Exceptional writing and presentation skills; you should be able to simplify the complex.
  • Background: Healthcare experience is a major plus, but a high Sales IQ and business stamina are non-negotiable.

Why this moment, why Springboard

If you want to own something and help build something that matters, this is it.

The healthcare workforce shortage isn't a trend; it's a crisis category. It’s the problem we exist to solve. If you want to move away from selling "nice-to-have" SaaS and start selling a mission-critical solution that fundamentally changes how people get hired and how hospitals function, let’s talk.

jobs.description:
Ben je nu interimmer, 'in between jobs' of werk je in een (commerciële) logistiek management functie?

Ben je ondernemend en geïnteresseerd in mensen en wat hen drijft?

Zie je kansen, ben je doortastend en maak je makkelijk contact?

Dan leren we jou graag kennen!

We zijn op zoek naar een Headhunter die doorpakt en ons netwerk verder helpt uitbouwen met kandidaten en opdrachtgevers.

Die samen met ons uitdagende vacatures succesvol invult!

  • Doe ik nu wat ik leuk vind en waar ik goed in ben?
  • Krijg ik voldoende waardering?
  • Is de werksfeer goed?
  • Maximaliseer ik mijn marktwaarde?

Als het antwoord op één of meer van die vragen niet 100% positief is zetten wij graag voor je op een rijtje waarom samenwerken in een rol als headhunter en Associate Partner bij Best Recruitment een unieke kans is:

  • Werken bij een snel groeiend zeer professioneel werving & selectiebureau met een duidelijke focus en visie op de toekomst;
  • Niet zomaar een franchiseformule, maar exclusieve samenwerking met behoud van zelfstandigheid heldere werkafspraken en zonder investeringsverplichting vooraf;
  • Een brede en gevarieerde functie. Afhankelijk van ervaring en ambitie houd je je naast werving & selectie ook met assessments en ander HR-advies bezig;
  • Meer dan professionele ondersteuning, zodat je je volledig kunt concentreren op de kern van je werk;
  • Ruimte om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om daadwerkelijk verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen succes;
  • Professionele coaching en begeleiding bij de verdere ontwikkeling van je competenties;
  • Een collegiale en stimulerende werksfeer;
  • Tot slot bieden wij je een uitstekend verdienmodel, waarin "the sky the limit" is.

Elke opdracht is maatwerk en samen krijgen we scherp naar welke kandidaat we op zoek zijn. Jij weet perfect met behulp van media en recruitmenttools de potentiële kandidaten in beeld te krijgen en aan tafel te krijgen. Dit doe je vooral door de telefoon te pakken en contact te maken.

We zijn ambitieus, groeien heel snel en willen kwaliteit (blijven) leveren. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar de persoonlijke verbinding met onze opdrachtgever en kandidaat. We hebben een directe en open bedrijfscultuur en geven en ontvangen graag constructieve feedback. We zoeken iemand die scherp is, de markt beter wil leren kennen en als persoon met ons meegroeit. Iemand die het ontzettend leuk vindt om nieuwe mensen te leren kennen.

Als Associate Partner fungeer je als aanspreekpunt en sparringpartner, zowel richting de klant als richting de kandidaat. We werken in een 360 graden model. Je krijgt energie van de dynamiek die samengaat met het opereren op executive niveau.

  • Ik beschik over een ruim netwerk op management en directieniveau;
  • Ik heb oprechte interesse in wat mensen beweegt en hen succesvol maakt; bovendien heb ik de overtuiging dat mensen het verschil maken;
  • Ik heb niet noodzakelijk werkervaring met werving & selectie maar ben er van overtuigd dat ik dat kan leren;
  • Ik vind het leuk om veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid te nemen;
  • Ik werk graag zelfstandig, maar wil regelmatig ook sparren om voor mijn klanten de beste oplossing te vinden en om zelf beter te worden;
  • Klanten kunnen ‘dag en nacht’ op mijn inzet rekenen en ik ben op directieniveau een ‘partner in business’;
  • Klanten beschrijven mij als: integer, eerlijk en professioneel;
  • Ik ben ondernemend en commercieel succesvol;
  • Ik ben een inspirerende collega met gevoel voor humor;
  • Ik heb HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Ik vind het interessant om bij andere organisaties aan tafel te zitten en te leren van de verschillende culturen en business modellen.

Als Associate Partner ben je zelf verantwoordelijk voor het verwerven van vacatures en invullen.

Uiteraard helpen we je graag op gang komen door vacatures en leads te delen en waar mogelijk of nodig partneren we intern voor vacatures om optimaal resultaat te behalen.

Dit betekent dat je niet vanaf 0 hoeft te beginnen en terug kan vallen op partners met raad en daad.

Uiteindelijk bepaal je zelf hoe veel en hard je werkt en welke profielen en bedrijven je mee wil partneren en daardoor ook direct wat je verdiensten zullen zijn.

Een persoonlijke omzettarget van 100k in het eerste jaar en 150k-250k daarna is marktconform afhankelijk van achtergrond en marktontwikkeling en je ambities als Associate Partner bij Best Recruitment

About Catch Creation

Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. Our team thrives in a fully remote environment, combining creativity, data-driven strategy, and innovation to build scalable eCommerce solutions that perform.

From concept to conversion, we specialize in developing brands that stand out in competitive markets—driven by a passion for design, storytelling, and customer satisfaction. Every product we launch reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and growth.

At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life.

Head of Retail Expansion

Location: Remote (US-based preferred) with travel required

Reports to: CEO

Type: Full-Time, Senior Leadership

About Muddy Mat

Muddy Mat is the market-leading pet-friendly home products brand, best known for our ultra-absorbent chenille door mats designed to trap mud, water, and dirt from pet paws and shoes. We sell across multiple categories including anti-mud mats, outdoor mats, dog beds, washable rugs, and accessories. With over 50,000 five-star reviews and a 9 figure a year brand, Muddy Mat has proven massive product-market fit as a direct-to-consumer brand selling through our own website, Amazon, Walmart.com, TikTok Shop, Chewy, and other digital channels.

Now we’re entering the next phase: taking Muddy Mat from a digital-first brand to a brand you can find on retail shelves worldwide. That’s where you come in.

The Role

The Head of Retail Expansion will own the strategy and execution of bringing Muddy Mat into physical retail and wholesale channels, both in the United States and internationally. This is not a store operations role. This is a senior business development and sales leadership position focused on getting Muddy Mat onto shelves at major retailers, building distributor relationships globally, and scaling a profitable retail channel from the ground up.

Core Responsibilities

Retail & Wholesale Expansion (US)

  • Identify, pitch, and close deals with major US retailers, including Target, Walmart (in-store), Costco, PetSmart, Chewy (physical), TJ Maxx, HomeGoods, Bed Bath & Beyond, and specialty pet retailers
  • Develop and execute the retail go-to-market strategy for each channel, including pricing, packaging, planogram positioning, and promotional planning
  • Negotiate terms, margins, co-op advertising, and shelf space agreements with category buyers
  • Own the retail P&L and be accountable for revenue targets and channel profitability

International Retail & Distribution

  • Build and manage relationships with international distributors to bring Muddy Mat into retail markets in the UK, EU, Canada, Australia, and other target regions
  • Evaluate and select distribution partners based on market coverage, retail relationships, logistics capability, and alignment with brand standards
  • Develop market entry strategies for each region, including pricing localization, regulatory compliance, and packaging requirements
  • Negotiate distributor agreements including exclusivity terms, minimum order commitments, margin structures, and performance benchmarks
  • Coordinate with internal teams on international inventory planning, forecasting, and supply chain logistics

Key Account Management & Sell-Through

  • Manage day-to-day wholesale account relationships with retail buyers at key chains
  • Monitor sell-through rates, manage reorder cycles, and optimize assortment by retailer
  • Drive in-store merchandising, brand presentation, and compliance across all retail touchpoints
  • Develop co-marketing programs with retail partners to accelerate sell-through velocity

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work with supply chain and operations to ensure inventory readiness for retail launches and reorders
  • Coordinate with marketing on retail-specific packaging, point-of-sale materials, and brand assets
  • Partner with finance on retail margin analysis, trade spend management, and channel profitability reporting
  • Collaborate with the e-commerce team to ensure retail strategy complements (not cannibalizes) DTC channels

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in retail sales, wholesale, or business development in consumer goods
  • Proven, demonstrable track record of taking a DTC or ecommerce-native brand into physical retail at national or big-box retailers (this is non-negotiable — we need someone who has done this before, not someone who wants to try)
  • Direct experience managing international distributors and launching products into retail markets outside the United States
  • Existing relationships with retail buyers at major chains in pet, home, housewares, or consumer goods categories
  • Deep understanding of retail economics: margin structures, trade spend, co-op programs, slotting fees, and promotional planning
  • Experience with retail-specific packaging, compliance, barcode/UPC requirements, and planogram standards
  • Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing complex, high-value retail agreements
  • Ability to own a P&L and be accountable for a revenue target

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience specifically in the pet products, home goods, or housewares categories
  • Background working at a high-growth DTC brand that successfully expanded into retail (not the other way around — we need the DTC-to-retail playbook)
  • Familiarity with Amazon and other marketplace dynamics and how they interact with retail channel strategy
  • Experience working with or selling into UK, EU, Canadian, and Australian retail markets
  • Existing distributor network in international markets
  • Experience managing retail broker relationships (Walmart, Target)

Why Muddy Mat

  • Market leader with over 50,000 five-star reviews and massive consumer demand already proven online
  • $200M+ annual revenue run rate with strong unit economics and gross margins above 85%
  • You’re not building from zero — you’re taking a brand with proven product-market fit and expanding it into an entirely new channel
  • Direct access to the CEO and a lean, high-performance leadership team with the resources and ambition to execute at scale
  • Opportunity to build the retail division from the ground up and own it entirely
  • Compensation package includes competitive base, performance bonus, and equity participation

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus tied to retail revenue targets. Equity participation available for the right candidate. Full benefits package.

jobs.title: Implementatie Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Wie ben jij?  Vind jij het leuk om onze applicaties optimaal te laten werken bij onze klanten?
jobs.description:
Wie ben jij?
Vind jij het leuk om onze applicaties optimaal te laten werken bij onze klanten? Dan hebben wij de baan die jij zoekt! In een betrokken team installeer je door ons ontwikkelde IT-oplossingen bij onze klanten en integreer je deze in een bestaand applicatielandschap. Je voelt je goed bij het onderhouden van een goede klantrelatie en wordt enthousiast van een technische uitdaging waarbij jouw toegevoegde waarde direct zichtbaar wordt. Daarnaast hecht je als punctueel persoon waarde aan het nakomen van je (klant)afspraken, een correcte (klant)administratie en een kloppende eigen planning. Uiteraard ondersteunen we je hierin, zodat jij een nog betere consultant wordt! Spreekt dit je aan? Lees dan snel verder of solliciteer direct!

Hoe ziet jouw functie eruit?
Als Implementatie Consultant implementeer je onze eigen toonaangevende IT-oplossingen voor overheden die kwalitatieve geografische data registreert en deelt. Deze data worden door vele inwoners, bedrijven en organisaties gebruikt. Jij zorgt ervoor dat klanten optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van onze IT-oplossingen: je implementeert, configureert en traint gebruikers. Dit kan vanuit huis, op kantoor en op locatie bij de klant.

Je werkt veelal zelfstandig, maar deelt jouw ideeën en ervaringen met enthousiaste collega’s om hier gezamenlijk van te kunnen leren. Op die manier draag je bij aan continue verbetering van onze werkwijze, dienstverlening en (technische) oplossing met het ultieme doel: een blije klant, maar ook een tevreden medewerker!

Binnen Vicrea vinden we jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en werkplezier ook heel belangrijk. Daarom besteden we hier veel tijd aan! We kennen bijvoorbeeld een Young Professional programma, een Talent Development programma en er is veel ruimte voor individuele “coaching on the job”. Goede resultaten behalen is volgens ons niet mogelijk zonder een goede dosis werkplezier! Hiervoor organiseren we regelmatig game-avonden, borrels en teamuitjes. Daarnaast zorgen we ervoor dat je als Implementatie Consultant wordt uitgerust met een geschikte werkplek!

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je hebt ervaring met het installeren van applicaties in een Windows-omgeving;
  • je hebt kennis van databases en SQL;
  • je bent gedreven, leergierig en een teamplayer met analytisch vermogen;
  • je bent resultaatgericht, goed in prioriteren en proactief;
  • je bent ambitieus en beschikt over HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau;
  • je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;
  • je bent beschikbaar voor 32-40 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De mogelijkheid om samen met jouw team mee te werken aan de verdere groei van Vicrea;
  • ruimte om je als consultant door te ontwikkelen door je kennis te vergroten en vaardigheden uit te breiden;
  • uitstekende primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden met o.a. een leaseauto, dertiende maand, goede pensioenregeling, 27 vakantiedagen, een laptop (incl. accessoires) en een mobiele telefoon;
  • een fijne werkplek en een prettige informele werksfeer in ons kantoor in Amersfoort;
  • leuke collega’s die er naar uit kijken om jou welkom te heten in het team en een ambitieuze bedrijfscultuur.

Over Vicrea
Wij zijn een Nederlands IT-bedrijf, gespecialiseerd in slimme data-integratie oplossingen, Geografische Informatie Systemen en maatwerk toepassingen. Wij transformeren data naar waardevolle informatie. Zo'n 100 getalenteerde en betrokken medewerkers ontwikkelen standaard- en maatwerksoftware, adviseren en ontzorgen onze klanten. Hierdoor kunnen organisaties effectiever en efficiënter functioneren. Vicrea is sinds de oprichting in 1999, uitgegroeid tot de marktleider op het gebied van ruimtelijke informatietechnologie. Wij spelen in op de nieuwste technologieën en zijn daarom de concurrentie vaak een stap voor. Dit vullen we aan met een gezonde dosis lef, waardoor we iedere uitdaging aankunnen. Voor zowel starters als ervaren professionals heeft Vicrea vaak plek. Kijk voor meer informatie over Vicrea verder op onze website.

Reageren
Herken je je in het bovenstaande profiel? Solliciteer dan direct!

Heb je nog vragen hebt kun je contact opnemen met onze Manager Operations Maikel Nijmeijer via 088-5004600.

Hoe gaan wij met je gegevens om?
Wij hechten grote waarde aan je privacy. Wij gaan dan ook uiterst zorgzaam om met de gegevens die jij aan ons beschikbaar stelt. Deze gegevens zullen door ons vertrouwelijk worden behandeld en uitsluitend worden gebruikt voor werving- en selectiedoeleinden. Wij zullen geen informatie verstrekken aan derden, tenzij wij daartoe op grond van de wet verplicht zijn. Door het versturen jouw sollicitatie ga je ermee akkoord dat je persoonsgegevens worden verwerkt door onze organisatie.

Wij hebben begrip voor acquisitie, maar geen interesse.

jobs.description:
SEO Content Marketer - Job Description

About the Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and creative SEO Content Marketer who can craft high-quality content while ensuring it ranks well on search engines. This role combines strategic content marketing with in-depth SEO expertise to drive organic traffic, conversions, and improve search visibility for our clients.

As an SEO Content Marketer, you’ll be responsible for creating, optimizing, and managing content that attracts, educates, and converts our audience.

We’re looking for an SEO Content Marketer who understands that ranking on page one is only half the battle, the real win is getting B2B SaaS buyers to take action.

More importantly, you know how to use AI tools to your advantage; to speed up research, spark ideas, and optimize content, but you don’t let them replace your creativity, strategic thinking, or human touch.

If you can turn complex SaaS topics into compelling, data-driven narratives that both Google and real people love, we want to talk to you. And if you cringe at the sight of a blog post starting with “In the dynamic world of…”, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Holistic SEO & Content Strategies

  • Develop a data-driven content strategy focused on high-intent B2B SaaS keywords.
  • Conduct keyword research, topic clustering, and competitor analysis to uncover ranking opportunities.
  • Own and manage the content calendar, ensuring a steady flow of optimized, insightful, and conversion-focused content.

SEO-Optimized Content Creation

  • Write and optimize blog posts, pillar pages, case studies, landing pages, and industry research reports, all with a focus on ranking and converting.
  • Balance technical accuracy with compelling storytelling. You know how to turn complex SaaS topics into digestible, high-value content.
  • Craft SEO-friendly meta titles, descriptions, and CTAs that increase click-through rates.
  • Create content for blogs, social media platforms, email sequences, and ad copy.

On-Page SEO

  • Optimize internal linking to improve navigation and content discoverability.
  • Ensure content follows best practices for readability, mobile-friendliness, and structured data (schema markup).
  • Work with developers to identify SEO issues (site speed, indexing, crawlability).

Content Distribution & Link Building

  • Promote content through email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
  • Execute guest blogging and digital PR strategies to build authoritative backlinks.
  • Optimize for AIO, featured snippets, People Also Ask (PAA), and Google Discover.

Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversion metrics using Google Analytics, Search Console, HubSpot, and Semrush.
  • Continuously refresh and update old content to maintain rankings and relevance.
  • A/B test headlines, formats, and content structures to improve engagement.

What We’re Looking For:

Working in our team means embracing self-improvement. We don’t expect perfection, but attention to detail, endless curiosity, humility, and the desire to level up fast. We own our work by seeking responsibility and accountability for the ideas we create. We ask “Why?” a lot, and share our goals and experiences to challenge our thinking. We uncover impactful insights that raise our clients to new levels.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of experience in SEO-driven content marketing for North American B2B SaaS companies.
  • A portfolio of high-ranking, high-converting content (show us your wins!).
  • Deep understanding of Google’s ranking factors, E-E-A-T principles, search intent, and AI-powered search channels.
  • Proficiency in SEO tools like SEMrush, Clarity, and Screaming Frog.
  • Experience with CMS platforms like HubSpot, WordPress, and Webflow..
  • Ability to use AI writing tools strategically, but never let them dilute your originality.
  • Strong grasp of GA4 and Search Console for performance tracking.
  • A sharp eye for content trends in the B2B SaaS space (you know what resonates with b2b buyers).

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have Skills)

  • Familiarity with B2B lead generation and CRO (conversion rate optimization).
  • Knowledge of YouTube SEO and video content optimization for SaaS brands.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS sales funnels and marketing automation tools.

About Kalungi

Kalungi was founded to focus specifically on business-to-business (B2B) Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) companies.

Unlike most agencies, we own the full spectrum. From marketing strategy and positioning to campaign management and website optimization. Kalungi brings extensive experience in leadership, strategic direction, and a clear ‘B2B SaaS Success Blueprint’ proven to generate millions of dollars in attributed revenue for clients around the world. Kalungi prides itself on mentorship, education, and an entrepreneurial spirit to take on new challenges and improve every day.

Company Values

At Kalungi, we want to stand for more than just the outcomes of our daily work. How we do our work, who we work with and why we do this, is critical. Here are our core values to keep us grounded as a company. We apply these for hiring, development, evaluation, coaching, prioritizing and celebrating our work.

We love our craft

We are passionate, curious, and inquisitive about our work. We have fun, infuse soulfulness, and don’t take ourselves too seriously. We pursue mastery, hold ourselves to high standards, and seek to define the best practices in our industry. We’re lifelong learners who grow by challenging ourselves and sharing skills with others.

We execute for results

We believe in doing the right things, not more things. We recognize that a great strategy is only an idea without excellent follow-through. So, we constantly ask “why” to understand every project’s place in the big picture, ground ideas pragmatically, and execute for results with a calculated blend of speed and quality.

We lead with integrity

At the core of our foundation is integrity—a commitment to kindness, honesty, and accountability. Our actions match our words. We operate with good intentions and build productive, positive relationships.

We foster open dialogue

We thrive in a culture of open dialogue. We actively give, receive, and seek honest, clear feedback, then find opportunities to act on it. Transparency is our guiding principle, where spirited debate is encouraged, feedback is constructive, and we commit to continual improvement.

We act as one team

Collaboration is our heartbeat. We avoid silos, embrace the interdependence of our roles, and understand that our collective strength is what makes us unique. Alignment towards shared goals keeps us productive and efficient. We celebrate our successes and support each other through challenges.

We are very excited about the opportunity of working with you! We look forward to hearing from you!

- The Kalungi Team

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary with performance-based reviews
  • Flexibility: Unlimited PTO and fully remote work.
  • Team Culture: A collaborative and supportive team that lives our core values daily.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a cover letter to explaining how you’ll add value to Kalungi and why you’re a great fit for the role.

Kalungi is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workforce. Employment at Kalungi is based solely on a person's qualifications directly related to professional competence. Kalungi does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of age, color, creed, disability, gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.description:
Fully remote role!

Who we are

PartsTech is an automotive technology company. We help repair shops find the right parts fast. One search shows you live inventory and wholesale pricing from all of a shop’s parts suppliers.

Repair shops rely on us to provide them with access to the necessary parts inventory to keep vehicles moving through their bays as quickly as possible.

How we run things

We always start with our product vision: we make it fast and easy for auto repair shops to find the right parts across all of their suppliers with one search.

As a Product Manager you will report to the VP of Product and you will be a part of the product team which currently consists of product management, technical product management, product design, and user research. You will own at least one major area of the product or overall ecosystem. You’re responsible for identifying problems worth solving, prioritizing, contributing to the roadmap, and owning the execution and delivery.

We already have great product designers. We are not looking for someone who wants to own design, but instead contributes where applicable to the design thinking process.You will be paired with a product designer where together you will help shape the future of the product. Our engineering team is awesome. Whatever we come up with they push to make it happen (just check out our product and you’ll see).

Where we’re located

We have strong roots in Massachusetts and Connecticut, but we’re a global team. You can expect to be working with team members throughout the U.S. and overseas.

What we’re looking for

You have a startup mentality. You are completely comfortable in an environment that moves quickly and easily pivots as new product-changing information becomes available. This doesn’t mean we’re changing the roadmap every two weeks, but it does mean we avoid the sunk cost fallacy (we don’t move forward with bad decisions just because we already put time into something). If you don’t meet everything on this list, but feel you are still a competitive candidate for the role, then apply.

  • Comfortable working in an OKR environment
  • You’re really good at asking why and truly understanding the problem
  • You don’t just deliver features, you solve problems that translate into great features
  • Experience in delivering incremental value, measuring, then modifying as needed until the desired result is achieved
  • Ideally an example of sunsetting at least one feature
  • Experience working with data and knowing the difference between being data informed vs data driven (we are more of a data informed environment)
  • Experience in SaaS and E-commerce is preferred
  • Experience with consumer products or B2B products that have delivered an experience expected of a consumer product
  • Experience with e-commerce search and results (or different search with same level of complexity)
  • Very familiar with design thinking and can give clear examples of how it is applied
  • Has participated in or directly led design sprints
  • Works directly with customers weekly to help uncover problems worth solving
  • Understands how to correctly work with and utilize a user researcher

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

PartsTech is a next-generation ordering platform designed to help professional technicians save time and reduce the hassle associated with wholesale automotive parts procurement. With a single search, a technician can instantaneously locate, evaluate and order parts from both local suppliers as well as national warehouses. PartsTech provides the latest product descriptions, images, and schematics directly from manufacturers, giving technicians the best possible information when purchasing parts.

Risepoint is an education technology company that provides world-class support and trusted expertise to more than 100 universities and colleges. The Impact You Will Make

Risepoint is poised to transform the organization using technology and an AI-first mindset. We are seeking a strategic and highly motivated Sr Director of Digital Product & AI Strategy to lead the discovery, definition, and development of technology solutions that enhance the end-to-end lifecycle of online university programs. Own AI/digital use case development, work with a cross-functional team to drive build vs buy decisions, and identify solutions with a rigorous, ROI first lens.

In this role, you will uncover friction points universities face—from student discovery and application to enrollment, persistence, and graduation—and turn those insights into scalable digital products that enhance outcomes for students and institutional partners.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who combines strong product vision, analytical thinking, and exceptional execution skills. They have deep knowledge of university systems and processes and can confidently engage with senior leaders at partner institutions. This person thrives in an environment with limited oversight, demonstrates outstanding communication and executive presence, and can independently drive complex, multi-stakeholder product initiatives from concept through delivery.

The ideal candidate is an experienced product leader who combines deep product management expertise with strong knowledge of higher education systems, student lifecycle processes, and enterprise technology solutions. This role would be strategically focused and would not have any direct reports during the initial year.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

University Lifecycle Opportunity Identification & Product Strategy

  • Conduct deep discovery to identify pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs across the online program lifecycle, including marketing, recruitment, admissions, onboarding, student support, and academic progression.
  • Analyze partner processes, systems, personas, and workflows to uncover opportunities for innovation and digital transformation.

AI Strategy & Use Case Development

  • Work with cross-functional owners to own the tech transformation roadmap (AI/Digital): intake, prioritization, and sequencing of a focused set of high-impact initiatives across functions
  • Identify and prioritize a small number of high-value opportunities tied to measurable outcomes (conversion, cost-to-serve, speed, quality)
  • Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and assess AI/digital tools, vendors, and solution approaches with a rigorous, ROI-first lens
  • Develop a measurement framework to baseline performance before AI/digital interventions and track impact post-deployment

Workflow Transformation

  • Redesign workflows end-to-end using a problem-led, future-back approach (not just layering AI or digital tools onto existing processes)
  • Define how roles, tasks, and decision-making shift with AI embedded
  • Partner with functions to move from insight → pilot → scaled workflow changes
  • Ensure solutions are durable, repeatable, and embedded into day-to-day operations

Product Strategy & Roadmapping

  • Develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap that aligns with business goals, partner needs, and the student experience.
  • Define success metrics and use experiments, insights, and analytics to drive continuous improvement.
  • Translate university painpoints into solutions.

Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with university partners to understand their operational models, technical ecosystems, decision structures, and growth goals.
  • Collaborate with partnerships, engineering, operations, marketing, and student success teams to shape product requirements and deliver scalable solutions.

Execution & Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle—from discovery and prioritization through launch and iteration.
  • Ensure proper documentation, communication, and change management to support adoption across partners and internal teams.
  • Lead requirement definition, including user stories, acceptance criteria, systems integration needs, and user flows.
  • Work closely with technical teams to ensure product delivery meets scope, timeline, quality, and performance expectations.

Leadership & Influence

  • Operate autonomously with minimal oversight; proactively identify issues and drive solutions.
  • Influence decisions across the organization using data-driven reasoning, storytelling, and a strong executive presence.

What Success Looks Like

  • Identify and deliver high-impact digital and AI-enabled solutions to reduce friction points in the partner journey that improve operational efficiency, enhance the university partner and student experience, and drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Build and execute a clear product and AI strategy roadmap that aligns cross-functional stakeholders, prioritizes the highest-value opportunities, and successfully moves initiatives from discovery through implementation and adoption.
  • Redesign workflows and business processes in a scalable, sustainable way by embedding technology and AI into day-to-day operations, resulting in improved speed, quality, decision-making, and organizational effectiveness.

How Impact Will be Measured

  • Develop and gain alignment on a multi-quarter digital product and enterprise AI roadmap that identifies and prioritizes high-impact opportunities across the university partner and student lifecycle, with clear business outcomes and success metrics defined.
  • Lead discovery, design, and implementation of a focused set of digital and AI-enabled workflow transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, user experience, speed, quality, or cost-to-serve across key business functions.
  • Establish strong cross-functional partnerships and scalable product management practices by creating repeatable processes for intake, prioritization, measurement, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of enterprise digital and AI initiatives.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

  • 8+ years of tech product management experience, with significant time spent in digital product leadership roles. (Must have)
  • Strong knowledge of university systems, processes, and online program operations (e.g., CRM, SIS, LMS, admissions workflows, student support models, marketing funnels). Either via experience with EdTech firms or with universities. (Must have)
  • Proven experience (within the last 2–4 years) driving AI-led product development and workflow transformation inside an organization, not just deploying tools or running pilots. You can point to workflows that changed and outcomes achieved, not just pilots that launched. (Must have)
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a builder mentality, strong ownership mindset, and growth-oriented approach to problem solving. Comfortable operating with ambiguity, establishing new processes and capabilities, and driving organizational transformation through innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement.

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Strong analytical mindset; able to structure ambiguous problems and make data-driven decisions.
  • Preferred - Experience working with or for higher education institutions
  • Preferred - Familiarity with integrations, APIs, middleware, and data pipelines in university ecosystems.

HCM School for Ministry

Leadership Development & Practicum Program

Welcome to the HCM School for Ministry.

The Hope Center Ministries (HCM) School for Ministry is a structured leadership development and practicum program designed to equip and prepare individuals for future ministry and operational roles within Hope Center Ministries.

This program exists to develop leaders who are spiritually grounded, operationally competent, and mission-aligned. Participants will grow through both structured curriculum and hands-on practicum experience across various ministry departments.

School for Ministry is not employment. It is a voluntary training program intended to prepare individuals for potential future opportunities within HCM. Completion of the program does not guarantee employment, nor are participants obligated to pursue employment. Those who desire to apply for positions following completion will enter the standard hiring process.

    • Practicum (On-the-Job Ministry & Operations Training)

Participants may engage in one or both components depending on calling, readiness, and ministry pathway.

The Quality Assurance Operator plays a crucial role in maintaining the daily operational quality of model activities and ensuring that agency-wide standards are met. This role supports the Talent Management and Relationship Management team by reviewing processes, checking for compliance, and ensuring that each creator’s strategy is being executed correctly and consistently.

Daily Operations & Monitoring

Quality & Compliance

Requirements

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Who We Are

At Trility Consulting®, we’ve built a strong, remote-work culture where people thrive, grow, and support each other – earning us Great Place to Work® Certification. Headquartered in Central Iowa, we embrace flexible schedules and collaboration across geographically distributed teams serving clients from all corners of the United States and globally.

About the Role

    Trility Consulting is actively seeking a Senior .NET Application Development Consultant who is an expert in their field and a powerhouse on the keyboard. In this role, you'll partner directly with Trility clients to design, build, modernize, and support production software solutions.

    You'll take clients from "napkin to production" by listening to their challenges with empathy, asking thoughtful questions, evaluating technical options, and using your problem-solving skills to discover the right approach. You'll own technical work from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support while helping clients build stronger engineering practices along the way.

As a Trility consultant, you'll be expected to understand the "why" behind the work, challenge assumptions when appropriate, communicate openly when something isn't working, and help clients arrive at solutions that balance technical excellence with business value.

What You Will Do

  • Partner directly with client teams to understand business challenges, evaluate technical options, and translate requirements into practical software solutions.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions across application design, APIs, event-driven systems, messaging, data synchronization, and user-facing experiences.

  • Share knowledge with client teams and contribute to a collaborative environment where the goal is not simply to deliver software, but to leave the client better equipped to maintain and evolve it.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and confidently recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience with strong expertise in .NET and C#, along with the ability and desire to work across evolving technologies and technical environments.
  • Proficiency developing applications using Angular, with a strong understanding of components, services, modules, and related application architecture.

  • Experience with WPF is preferred; strong proficiency with XAML or comparable UI frameworks is also valuable.

  • Knowledge of NetMQ is a plus, along with familiarity with comparable messaging and data synchronization frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing best practices, with a commitment to helping clients ship software confidently.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native development, including containerization, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Understanding of how to deliver software safely and efficiently into production through CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and deployment practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new coding environments, technologies, frameworks, and client-specific systems.

At Mindera, we don’t just "write code."

We build products we are proud of, with people we love. Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do. We partner with our clients to deliver high-performance, resilient, and scalable systems that impact users and businesses worldwide.

We are a collection of individuals with different stories, but one shared goal: to build a place where we actually want to work. We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role & The Challenge

We are looking for seasoned Senior .NET Developers who thrive in complex engineering environments, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and take ownership of the software they build.

Reliability and quality are fundamental to our platform, so we're seeking product-minded engineers with proven experience in cloud-native distributed systems and a strong sense of ownership throughout the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you'll be expected to contribute to architectural decisions, clearly articulate the trade-offs behind your technical choices, and take features from business refinement through implementation, deployment, and production monitoring. You'll work with modern engineering practices to build decoupled, maintainable systems that scale reliably in production.

Your role goes beyond writing C# code. You are expected to own the delivery pipeline end to end:

  • Refinement: Challenge ambiguous business requirements, analyze acceptance criteria, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Architecture: Design decoupled, scalable solutions using Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) patterns.
  • Execution: Write highly concurrent, thread-safe applications using .NET 8 or later, with a strong preference for composition over inheritance.
  • Verification: Treat Test-Driven Development (TDD) as an essential engineering practice by writing robust unit and integration tests using xUnit and WireMock to prevent regressions.
  • Delivery & Operations: Deploy through modern CI/CD pipelines and proactively monitor production telemetry using tools such as AWS CloudWatch, New Relic, and GitHub Actions to ensure rapid troubleshooting and operational excellence.

The Tech Stack

  • Core: C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core
  • Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Distributed Systems
  • Cloud & Messaging: AWS (ECS, EC2, SQS, SNS, S3)
  • Databases & Caching: SQL, NoSQL, Redis, Valkey, DynamoDB
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, TeamCity
  • Quality Assurance: xUnit, WireMock, SpecFlow

Requirements

You’ll be a Great Fit If...

  • Engineering Seniority: Solid experience designing and deploying complex, high-throughput backend systems using .NET.
  • Cloud-Native Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, particularly containerized workloads (ECS/EC2) and messaging services (SQS/SNS).
  • System Design Mastery: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection lifetimes, and the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline.
  • Concurrency Discipline: Expert knowledge of asynchronous programming in C#. You understand how the thread pool works and why synchronous blocking (for example, using `.Result` or `.Wait()`) can severely impact the scalability and reliability of web APIs.
  • API Design: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, idempotent operations, and global exception-handling strategies.
  • Communication: Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

It’s a Total Bonus If...

  • Production experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or RabbitMQ.
  • Strong understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs and Generative AI using .NET or Python, particularly for AI-assisted engineering workflows and SDLC automation.

  • Flexible working hours

  • Profit distribution for everyone

Other Good Things :

  • Remote culture: We have an office in Casablanca, but Minders work remotely from all over Morocco.
  • At the offices, we have a wide range of snacks to keep you fed and healthy and Partnerships with local businesses

Culture

Most of all you get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together in a politics-free environment. Our culture reflects our lean and self-organization attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication. Freedom and Responsibility go hand in hand, and we value commitment, feedback, and empathy.

At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera.

We partner with our clients, to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient and scalable software systems that create an impact in their users and businesses across the world.

You get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together.

We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.
